summary: Serlo is a patient retiree who leads a town of aging crusaders and keeps a deadly secret about a spring that stops time. He lost his temper only once.

feats.scene: Serlo slaps a gavel so hard it splits the oak block.
Serlo takes a fall from a porch step and stays calm.

name: Lleeorti
summary: Lleeorti is a nightclub owner who dabbles in forbidden rites and loves his daughter. A summoned demon ends his life before she can warn him.

feats.scene: Lleeorti hurls a candlestick at a summoned shadow and watches it pass through.
Lleeorti is flung across the backroom by an unseen force and gets back up.

name: Nauti
summary: Nauti is a self-mutilated crime queen who sewed her eyes and lips open to mirror her inner scars. She runs a lair of traps and shares a dark bond with her sibling.

feats.scene: Nauti springs a snare that clubs an intruder across the face.
Nauti shrugs off a thrown knife and a chair across the back.

name: Cornil
summary: Cornil is a timid scholar of old texts who admits she is a coward. After death she is raised as a puppet soldier, fighting better than she ever lived while explaining how to break the spell.

feats.scene: Cornil tackles a sister warrior while her own body fights against her will.
Cornil takes a chariot strike in the ribs and keeps fighting, unable to stop.

name: Ninri
summary: Ninri is a bullied teenager transformed into a green, energy-draining creature by a cruel experimenter. He wants to finish the mission and go back to normal, and he refuses to see anyone hurt.

feats.scene: Ninri drains a hero's strength and lifts a crumbling beam off a trapped civilian.
Ninri takes a heavy battering from a hero and keeps draining.

name: Ilterium
summary: Ilterium is a lonely occultist raised among cultists who imprisoned a being of dreams for decades. He spends his life trying to contact the captive.

feats.scene: Ilterium shoves a candle holder into a chalk circle to keep the ritual alive.
Ilterium falls across a stone floor and keeps chanting.

name: Terau
summary: Terau is a farm-raised soldier and special forces veteran whose body was reshaped by a lab's genetic trigger. He later reunites with his estranged daughters.

feats.scene: Terau pounds a jeep's hood flat with a hammer-like fist.
Terau walks out of a grenade blast with only scorched fatigues.

name: Eontcor
summary: Eontcor is an ordinary city resident who looks up in terror when the sky turns blood-red. He hopes his protector in the night is watching too.

feats.scene: Eontcor slams a shutter against the crimson glare.
Eontcor stumbles over a curb in the panic and gets back up.

name: Reaunto
summary: Reaunto is a distant industrialist whose scavenged machines let a pair of salvagers build a warsuit. The suit's artificial mind obeys only his name.

feats.scene: Reaunto's warsuit punches a hole through a slab of concrete at a salvage yard.
Reaunto's warsuit stands through a rain of falling girders.

name: Rivalrer
summary: Rivalrer is a prison genius who builds high-tech weapons in the workshop and breaks out repeatedly. He joins a council of rival selves for the sake of conquest.

feats.scene: Rivalrer fires a homemade blaster that melts a guard's rifle.
Rivalrer is thrown across a hall by an energy beam and rises coughing.

name: Seresval
summary: Seresval is a proud adviser banished from a royal court for ignoring a warning. A cursed ring warps him into a pale, grinning madman.

feats.scene: Seresval rips a wagon train apart with a burst of ring-fed fury.
Seresval is struck by a champion's blade and laughs through the wound.

name: Lleeru
summary: Lleeru is a ruthless magnate obsessed with a rival from the stars who crafts clones from stolen cells. He fights from an armored suit when persuasion fails.

feats.scene: Lleeru's armored suit smashes a reinforced door and crushes a turret.
Lleeru takes a point-blank hit from a hero while sealed in the suit.

name: Coseoar
summary: Coseoar is a cackling tycoon who leads a league of villains and a snake-like portal that teleports on demand. He keeps rare green glowing stones nearby.

feats.scene: Coseoar steps through a ring of light and slams a hero from behind.
Coseoar rides out a pounding in his battle suit and cackles on.

source_title: Alexander Luthor (DC Super Friends Web Series)

name: Terasti
summary: Terasti is a bald schemer driven by envy, orchestrating a war and building living weapons in a cell. His speeches are venomous and his plans cruel.

feats.scene: Terasti triggers a chain of bombs that levels a stretch of frontier buildings.
Terasti is beaten in a cell by guards and still gloats.

name: Valori
summary: Valori poses as a benevolent diplomat while quietly serving a shadow cabal. He speaks several languages and bends world leaders to his will.

feats.scene: Valori signs an order that sends a convoy of trucks into a mountain pass.
Valori takes a podium shove and recovers his smile.

name: Amoeoser
summary: Amoeoser is a charming tycoon posing as a philanthropist while hiring killers and murdering an infant from the stars. A camera trap exposes him, but bail frees him.

feats.scene: Amoeoser commands a pistol shot from a hired killer across a dark street.
Amoeoser is dragged off a stage by a masked kidnapper and brushes off the bruises.

name: Tutontel
summary: Tutontel is a bald genius who rose from industry to a throne of worlds, shaping a company, a planet, and an office. He pursues a title of tomorrow with unshakable ego.

feats.scene: Tutontel unleashes a salvo from a hovering war engine that levels a downtown.
Tutontel stands inside his armor as a barrage of missiles burst against it.

name: Corre
summary: Corre is a disembodied brain placed in a metal giant to resist alien invaders. His power source is torn out in battle, yet he helps strike down the enemy leader.

feats.scene: Corre punches through an invader's armored flank with a metal fist.
Corre takes a hail of invader blasts and fights on in emergency power.

name: Telnen
summary: Telnen is an opportunistic politician who exploits economic panic to win office. He outlaws masked heroes unless they serve him and arms himself with a battle suit.

feats.scene: Telnen's battle suit hurls a limousine across a plaza.
Telnen's battle suit withstands a hero's swing in a marble hall.

name: Niaamnu
summary: Niaamnu is a cartoonish tycoon who announces his new death ray in a press conference. He wears a battle suit and hoards glowing stones.

feats.scene: Niaamnu aims his ray at a billboard and vaporizes the whole thing in a blink.
Niaamnu bounces off a foam-padded stage wall in his suit and laughs.

source_title: Alexander Luthor (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Eonall
summary: Eonall is a scientist from a destroyed world who tries to perfect another by shipping villains to test subjects. He lives in a frozen fortress and manipulates a corporate matron.

feats.scene: Eonall detonates an experimental device that wrecks a laboratory complex.
Eonall is shoved against a freezer by a pursuing reporter and recovers quickly.

source_title: Alexander Luthor (The Mad Science of Dr. Atom)

name: Tumseniu
summary: Tumseniu is a maimed genius with a mechanical arm who plans to release a power-restoring bomb under a metropolis. He betrays his old rival to do it.

feats.scene: Tumseniu sets off a device beneath a metropolis that tears the whole district apart.
Tumseniu grips a cracked railing as his old rival hurls him aside.

name: Torleourn
summary: Torleourn is a former head of state who becomes a father figure to a young clone. He advises an army of heroes sent through time and fades with a changed timeline.

feats.scene: Torleourn raps a table and a squad of operatives steps forward.
Torleourn lurches back from an alien tentacle and stays on his feet.

name: Saulen
summary: Saulen is a newborn whose body becomes a vessel for a conquering god. It drains the powers of nearby heroes and inherits its parents' cruelty.

feats.scene: Saulen siphons the strength of two giants and flings it back as a city-shaking pulse.
Saulen takes a cosmic shockwave without waking from its cradle.

name: Llitauta
summary: Llitauta is a child prodigy of magnetism who believes he is a conqueror reborn. He kidnaps leaders and hides them in fields until a hero lures him away from his power.

feats.scene: Llitauta tears a bridge's girders free with a surge of magnetism and hurls them at a hero.
Llitauta stands in a storm of fire and steel, charged by captured machines.

name: Valaminu
summary: Valaminu is a cheerful throwing blade with a wing-shaped body, fused with a circuit board by two teenage tinkerers. Whenever danger nears, it banks around corners and returns to its makers with a chirp.

feats.scene: Valaminu curves through a row of cardboard targets and clatters back into a waiting glove.
Valaminu bounces off a brick wall with only a dented edge.

name: Vetaniu
summary: Vetaniu is a deckhand who bends sound into hard pulses, a skill picked up while serving on a rogue crew. Between storms he hums the waves flat and shatters crates with a shout.

feats.scene: Vetaniu focuses a shriek that splinters the mast of a rival skiff.
Vetaniu is thrown against the rail and gets back up winded.

name: Siunel
summary: Siunel is a bar regular who fakes a famous villain's reputation, armed with a humming prong-shaped sound weapon he once gambled away. Nobody has the heart to tell him the act fooled no one.

feats.scene: Siunel fires his humming prongs and knocks a bottle shelf into the mirror.
Siunel takes a thrown stool across the back and keeps bluffing.

name: Ticosti
summary: Ticosti is a blond brawler whose glowing ring of poison fumes can wrap a victim and squeeze. Across small farm towns she raids with her gang, until a streak of speed burns the ring away.

feats.scene: Ticosti tightens her fume ring around a farmer until he drops to his knees.
Ticosti shrugs off a thrown tractor wheel before her ring fades.

name: Oraosa
summary: Oraosa sells smuggled guns from behind a showroom desk and sprints on mechanical legs that spring him over parked vans. Beneath the polite smile he is a crippled dealer who trusts steel more than people.

feats.scene: Oraosa drives a kick through a car door as he vaults a showroom floor.
Oraosa pounds down an alley faster than any sprinter on the block.

name: Caeoleon
summary: Caeoleon is a yellow-eyed adventurer who loves aimless trips and flies without any destination. She carries a pair of bangles, a small crown and a rope that makes captives blurt truth, and one day she simply stiffens into stone.

feats.scene: Caeoleon swings her rope and flings a dozen guards across a plaza.
Caeoleon stands unmoved as a toppled column breaks over her shoulders.

name: Iuill
summary: Iuill is a pale, black-eyed brawler who flips, tumbles and hurls whatever she finds, soaring above the toy-brick streets. She belongs to a rowdy crowd of misfit duplicates and picks fights for fun.

feats.scene: Iuill lobs a stack of bricks and flattens a tower of crates.
Iuill lands from a rooftop dive and walks off laughing.

name: Nelcorca
summary: Nelcorca is a mirror-flawed giant who decided he had not been flawed enough and tore his own home world apart as a grown man. Having fled to a distant planet, he trampled a department store before ending his own life.

feats.scene: Nelcorca shatters his cube-shaped home with a single desperate blow.
Nelcorca walks out of the collapse of his world without a scratch.

name: Reonau
summary: Reonau is a first flawed duplicate who reverses every custom, hating beauty and loving ugliness, and married a duplicate reporter. Eventually he rose to guard his chalky cube of a world.

feats.scene: Reonau punches a hill into gravel while shouting backwards slogans.
Reonau stands at the center of a quarry blast and yawns.

name: Stoanniu
summary: Stoanniu is a clumsy, glowering failure of a lab experiment who joined a cabal of villains. Where a hero's gaze might warm, his glare freezes whatever it lands on, and he flies in a rage over the city.

feats.scene: Stoanniu freezes a whole tower solid with one furious stare.
Stoanniu is pummeled by three thugs and keeps smiling.

name: Rnilu
summary: Rnilu is a wonky, white-skinned giant who wants only to help yet muddles every rescue. He blows frost, stares ice and flies through toy cities, and he longs to reach the sun for reasons nobody follows.

feats.scene: Rnilu exhales frost across a harbor and locks every boat in ice.
Rnilu bounces back from a falling bridge span, thrilled at the noise.

name: Rusmilnus
summary: Rusmilnus is a pale, dark-eyed raider with a body that follows no known rules, swinging weapons at a besieged cliff fortress. Among a rabble of outlaws he is just another soldier of the great army.

feats.scene: Rusmilnus hacks through a gate with a single wild swing.
Rusmilnus takes a volley of arrows to the chest and presses on.

name: Tautirne
summary: Tautirne is a pale-skinned petty criminal belonging to a band of mirrored heroes who do everything the wrong way round. She wears a glum smirk and a stolen sash.

feats.scene: Tautirne flips a parked scooter into a shopfront.
Tautirne laughs off a collision with a lamppost.

name: Veotiaam
summary: Veotiaam is a green-eyed blond hero who shuns the sea and shouts at fish from dry land. His team rescues people by accident and returns home to cheers it cannot understand.

feats.scene: Veotiaam hoists a rowboat overhead and hurls it at a harbor wall.
Veotiaam shrugs when a crate lands on his head.

name: Reoialcar
summary: Reoialcar is a grey-skinned member of a mirrored hero league who dwells on a cube-shaped world. A giant vessel from the sky crushes him with the rest of his team in a single moment.

feats.scene: Reoialcar fires a wobbly volley of arrows at the sky vessel.
Reoialcar endures the first shockwave of the landing before it ends him.

name: Aucoor
summary: Aucoor is a worst-of-all sleuth, formed by a bumbling giant as a partner on trips between two worlds. He loves chaos, even sided with a clown, and gets sent home for tidying a place that should stay broken.

feats.scene: Aucoor hurls a smoke pellet that fills a ballroom with confusion.
Aucoor falls through a skylight and complains about the glass.

name: Taauinu
summary: Taauinu is a crumbling-skinned inhabitant of a mirrored hero league on a tilted cube world, imitating an insect-themed champion. Like his teammates, he is misshapen and brief.

feats.scene: Taauinu smashes a stone bench with one overhead swing.
Taauinu takes a falling beam and cracks it in half.

name: Tuvastu
summary: Tuvastu is a black-haired knockoff of a lightning-summoning champion, living among a reversed hero society. He says his magic word backwards and nothing much happens.

feats.scene: Tuvastu leaps off a ledge and cracks the pavement with a stomp.
Tuvastu sits unharmed under a toppled statue.

name: Tetis
summary: Tetis is a pale, sleepy runner who brags of being the laziest of all and yawns through each rescue. When he does move he is quick, which rarely helps the team he joins.

feats.scene: Tetis bolts across a field in a blur and then dozes on the far side.
Tetis tips a market stall with a lazy shove.

name: Meoran
summary: Meoran is a grey-skinned runner who was copied from a wind-footed champion and then joined a squad that tried to flatten a monster with a flying base. Tests of his speed are rarely recorded.

feats.scene: Meoran helps heave a floating headquarters down on a monster.
Meoran staggers out of a crater, brushing dust from his sleeves.

name: Tiaeonnau
summary: Tiaeonnau is a blond, black-eyed girl who flies and visits a small town of sidekicks, announcing proudly that she has every talent. She adores her pet duck and her first crush, who moves a little too fast.

feats.scene: Tiaeonnau tosses a toy truck into a hedge from the air.
Tiaeonnau tumbles through a fence and giggles.

name: Sausese
summary: Sausese is a brown-haired citizen of a mirrored underworld who owns a glowing ring in his nose that conjures only what he cannot imagine. Since his mind imagines everything, the ring never does a thing.

feats.scene: Sausese strains until a faint green glow flickers and fades.
Sausese is knocked into a barrel and sits there puzzled.

name: Iumnti
summary: Iumnti is a grey, feathered-style duplicate who shrieks instead of speaking and fights beside a squad of mirrored heroes. She helped drop a flying headquarters onto a monster and perished soon after.

feats.scene: Iumnti dives from above and rams a pillar down on a crowd of raiders.
Iumnti takes a falling wall on her back and shrieks defiantly.

name: Ilnacar
summary: Ilnacar is a tall winged copy whose skin is a faceted crystal like crumbled chalk, unbothered by sunlight. He wanders a cube-shaped world as an adventurer and reverses every sensible choice.

feats.scene: Ilnacar beats a crystal club against a boulder and splits it.
Ilnacar is buried in a rockslide and climbs out shining.

name: Telicol
summary: Telicol is a grey-skinned member of a reversed hero league, a woman who frosts her surroundings just as a famous counterpart does. A giant vessel from above ended her along with her team.

feats.scene: Telicol freezes a fountain solid in a single breath.
Telicol resists the first rumble of the falling vessel before it ends her.

name: Loole
summary: Loole is a green-haired clown reflection who is not mad at all, so he sees no reason to scheme against the heroes of his cube world. Left idle and gloomy, he mostly sits and sighs.

feats.scene: Loole throws a limp pie that barely reaches a bench.
Loole is knocked from a stool and just stays on the floor.

name: Anlanti
summary: Anlanti is a green-haired grey-skinned clown copy among countless others stamped out by a sun-soaked creator. His thinking runs opposite to logic, and his jokes land backwards.

feats.scene: Anlanti flings a hat full of marbles that scatters across a platform.
Anlanti falls down a stairwell and bounces up grinning.

name: Llliu
summary: Llliu is an orange-eyed green-skinned pet beast, freed from an icy vault by a lumbering new owner and carried to a cube world. It has claws, fangs and nimble legs and acts like any excited dog.

feats.scene: Llliu lunges and rakes a steel door open with its claws.
Llliu tumbles from a ledge and trots off wagging.

name: Nasatum
summary: Nasatum is a red-haired, green-eyed stand-in made for a monster film shot on a cube world. She refuses to kiss the monster, saying she would not even if he were the last man alive, and is sent home.

feats.scene: Nasatum swats a prop torch across a film set.
Nasatum steps out of a collapsed set unharmed.

name: Sonlorral
summary: Sonlorral is a bald, black-eyed schemer who brews a poison to make everyone as hairless as himself and calls himself the greatest hero. He lets loose a secret weapon, a hulking beast that hunts rival copies.

feats.scene: Sonlorral unleashes a monster that levels a whole row of shacks.
Sonlorral takes a falling signpost and keeps lecturing.

name: Rniiarirn
summary: Rniiarirn is a grey-skinned, black-eyed wife of a giant on a cube world, scolding the heroes for stopping a planned bombing. She backs lies, injustice and her own odd idea of patriotism.

feats.scene: Rniiarirn slams a stack of ledgers on a desk and splits it.
Rniiarirn is flung into a wall and dusts herself off.

name: Antereo
summary: Antereo is a grey-skinned sidekick duplicate, the first of many spawned when a ray struck his mentor. His very first word is goodbye, and a rampaging monster smashes him moments later.

feats.scene: Antereo swings a tiny cape and hits nothing at all.
Antereo is hammered into the ground before he can take a second breath.

name: Sonnan
summary: Sonnan is a gray-haired, black-eyed junior hero that exists in a daydream, wearing a tool-filled belt and marching with a squad of play-acting youths. He lives on a cube-shaped world.

feats.scene: Sonnan tosses a toy gadget that pops against a wall.
Sonnan tumbles off a sofa and giggles.

name: Irntiaiu
summary: Irntiaiu is a brown-haired, black-eyed girl in a daydreamed squad of mirrored youths, a cousin of a fiery space princess. She exists on a cube world only in a child's imagination.

feats.scene: Irntiaiu shoots a crayon-bright blast that fizzles on a toy fort.
Irntiaiu is bumped off a swing and bounces.

name: Osallotel
summary: Osallotel is a flying, nearly indestructible youth from a distant future who was turned away by a club of young heroes. He answered by stamping out mocking copies and demanding that worthless stones be turned to coal.

feats.scene: Osallotel punches through a vault door and sends a stack of crates tumbling.
Osallotel stays standing after a whole cliff collapses on him.
Osallotel streaks over a canyon faster than sound.

name: Irnvalval
summary: Irnvalval is a black-haired, white-skinned giant resident of a cube world, wandering streets with no plan. A blue mineral sickens him, like all his kind.

feats.scene: Irnvalval bats a barrel across a street and breaks a window.
Irnvalval is struck by a cart and does not notice.

name: Ulren
summary: Ulren is a blond grey-skinned toy maker copy who locks rivals into a stronghold built by his creator. He builds absurd inventions and takes pride in every failed one.

feats.scene: Ulren winds up a clockwork robot that bursts through a plank door.
Ulren falls out of a workshop window and shrugs it off.

name: Eonla
summary: Eonla is a warrior woman of a mirrored underworld who, doing the opposite of her model, turned from a living figure into a hardened clay statue. Her mind is fuzzy, and she now simply stands on a plinth.

feats.scene: Eonla swings a clay arm and cracks a post.
Eonla survives a tumble from her plinth with a single chip.

name: Luunnu
summary: Luunnu is a tall, blue-eyed, black-haired woman, a pale reflection of a famous warrior who lives on a cube world. A certain blue mineral robs her of strength.

feats.scene: Luunnu hammers a stone post flat with her fists.
Luunnu is dropped from a tower and strolls off.

name: Inlansa
summary: Inlansa is a grey-skinned, black-haired fighter who carries a rope that forces its captives to lie. She dropped a flying fortress on a monster alongside her team.

feats.scene: Inlansa stands up after a hard collision with a stone arch.

name: Ntean
summary: Ntean is a black-haired, pale woman who chants her spells in reverse, living on a cube-shaped world. Whatever she conjures turns out the opposite of her wish.

feats.scene: Ntean mutters a backwards verse and a bench flips over.
Ntean lands in a flower bed and waves.

name: Loramo
summary: Loramo is a yellow-eyed, brown-haired woman who resents her husband and son and fights them constantly, firing guns and swinging powerful fists. She is married to a giant and mothers a young hero.

feats.scene: Loramo swings a table at her family and splits it against a wall.
Loramo takes a thrown anvil and shakes her head.

name: Lotaceo
summary: Lotaceo is a white-eyed, blonde brute who can take on any shape yet dislikes his own face too much to try. He fights beside a gang of reversed heroes and keeps his old features in every form.

feats.scene: Lotaceo stretches into a mallet and smashes a truck door.
Lotaceo flows around a swung beam and reforms unhurt.

name: Tatavi
summary: Tatavi is a white-eyed, black-haired inventor of dim ideas who throws sticky globs and weapons at a team of heroes. His genius is for stupidity and his gadgets rarely work as meant.

feats.scene: Tatavi lobs a glob that glues a car to a lamppost.
Tatavi is bounced off a billboard and squints.

name: Starntel
summary: Starntel is a stretchy, black-haired villain who flings his own arms and legs like projectiles at rivals, then watches the pieces rot away. He answers to a silly nickname and always loses parts.

feats.scene: Starntel fires a detached fist that dents a truck.
Starntel is flattened by a roller and inflates back.

name: Ausul
summary: Ausul is a dark-haired boy knight who rides a loyal steed and speaks in flowery boasts, courting maidens who do not want him. He sprays rivals with water pistols and helps rescue a dying world.

feats.scene: Ausul charges on his steed and topples a watchman's booth.
Ausul is thrown from the saddle and bounces up unhurt.

name: Telrn
summary: Telrn is a dark-haired knight of a topsy-turvy order who wields a glowing emerald band that builds shields, fires blasts and carries him aloft. He misspells his own title and quarrels with a rival in yellow.

feats.scene: Telrn fires a green bolt that collapses a whole warehouse.
Telrn raises a glowing barrier and holds off a barrage of cannon shells.

name: Inureium
summary: Inureium is a blue-eyed boy of a chalky-skinned race who flies, breathes fire, stares frost and shrugs off blows. His quarrelsome parents make home life miserable, and his friends rescue him from it.

feats.scene: Inureium breathes a plume of flame that melts a bridge.
Inureium shakes off a falling tower and sulks.

name: Liseonnu
summary: Liseonnu is a quilled hybrid beast made in a mad surgeon's lab, sworn to obey a code of cruel laws. He stalks city streets with his pack and, at the end, sides with his maker.

feats.scene: Liseonnu swipes a claw through a lamppost.
Liseonnu keeps charging through a line of police batons.

name: Iantitau
summary: Iantitau is a dark-haired criminal who vanishes from one alley and appears in another, armed with a plain cane and an ordinary pistol. Nobody ever learns how the trick works.

feats.scene: Iantitau fires a pistol from a spot he was not standing in a moment ago.
Iantitau takes a punch to the jaw and blinks away.

name: Artieru
summary: Artieru is a warlord from a far tomorrow who flies in a full suit of armor, fires beams from a lance and rides a time machine surrounded by robot drones. A trick about ancestry sends him home.

feats.scene: Artieru blasts a laboratory wall to rubble with a lance of force.
Artieru absorbs a barrage of rockets inside his armor.

name: Rentser
summary: Rentser is a future thief in scarab armor who joins a gang of time raiders after being promised his sister could be saved. He steals the name of a beetle hero and travels through time to rewrite the past.

feats.scene: Rentser rips a gash in a time ship's hull with a scarab blade.
Rentser survives a blast that nearly shatters his vessel.

name: Anuntta
summary: Anuntta is a blond hero that exists only because a mischievous imp reversed everyone's gender. He appears on a space station and does little before the trick fades.

feats.scene: Anuntta shoves a console cart across the station deck.
Anuntta bumps a doorframe and rubs his head.

name: Vartaumi
summary: Vartaumi is a dark-haired forger who staged his own funeral to dodge the law. A young hero in a lightning-powered suit tracked him down and he was caught among his fake bills.

feats.scene: Vartaumi flings a roll of coins at a pursuer.
Vartaumi takes a tackle onto a printing table.

name: Resanu
summary: Resanu is a genderless, purple, eyeless creature of death freed by accident in a possible tomorrow. Its body stretches like taffy, its touch kills and it glides after victims at ruinous speed.

feats.scene: Resanu reaches through a vault wall and kills its target with one touch.
Resanu overtakes a fleeing runner in an eyeblink.

name: Anile
summary: Anile is a white-eyed reaper who lives inside a river of raw velocity and collects those who race too hard. Wearing a calm mask, he waits at the finish line of every contest.

feats.scene: Anile crosses a stadium before the starting gun finishes echoing.
Anile takes a champion runner's last breath with a single glance.

name: Tauerosa
summary: Tauerosa is a genderless red-eyed antibody grown by a river of speed to kill anything that harms it. It also collects the souls of runners whose time has come, arriving as a grey blur.

feats.scene: Tauerosa lunges across a museum floor and drains a fleeing runner in an instant.
Tauerosa closes a continent-wide gap while its target blinks.

name: Serntrau
summary: Serntrau is a bald, yellow-eyed grim reaper of speed that feeds on life and velocity, with claws, brute strength and a tough hide. It tried to swallow a young runner's pure speed and died when the boy let it loose.

feats.scene: Serntrau claws a trench across a dusty plain in one rush.
Serntrau stands in a roaring blast of released speed before it ends him.

name: Valceo
summary: Valceo is a black-haired boatman turned criminal who poles through canals and meets a quick end in his first outing. Little is recorded of his methods beyond a grudge against a tiny hero.

feats.scene: Valceo swings his long pole and cracks a crate lid.
Valceo is knocked off his gondola into the canal.

name: Rnianu
summary: Rnianu is a general in a drowned king's army who wears a mask that fires thin lasers. He cut down a mercenary with a single beam and fell to a hail of bullets after his helmet broke.

feats.scene: Rnianu fires lasers from his mask and drops a mercenary on the spot.
Rnianu takes a punch while his helmet holds.

name: Ciston
summary: Ciston is a hired diver in a suit of dark armor, sent by a toy-maker's firm to take down a sea hero around the early eleven years of the century. His few moves are recorded in a single mission.

feats.scene: Ciston rams a harbor gate with an armored shoulder.
Ciston lands on a dock plank and the armor holds.

name: Neserrn
summary: Neserrn is a red-eyed, hairless hero from a mirror reality, a sea raider turned defender who fights on the side of the law. Little else is known about his deeds.

feats.scene: Neserrn hammers a smuggler's crate shut with one fist.
Neserrn steps through a doorway wrecked by a bomb and keeps walking.

source_title: Black Manta (The Brave and the Bold: Deep Cover for Batman!)

name: Rinallu
summary: Rinallu is a bald, masked crime boss who ran a gang until a vigilante's radio voice led police to his door. Nothing is recorded of him beyond that single arrest.

feats.scene: Rinallu swings a club at a detective and misses.
Rinallu is dragged into a cell and shouts about his lawyers.

name: Eoamo
summary: Eoamo is a retired thug in a suit with glove-tip dispensers that puff out deadly spores. His costume gets stolen from a police locker, and he later helps a convict slip out of prison.

feats.scene: Eoamo puffs spore gas into a stairwell and clears it of guards.
Eoamo coughs through a punch and stumbles on.

name: Tastisu
summary: Tastisu is a grey, white-haired guard who is half caped hero and half hulking undead, babbling in broken sentences. He holds the gate of a bat-shaped fortress and brawls with a powerful flyer.

feats.scene: Tastisu blows a tunnel wall into a spray of masonry.
Tastisu keeps swinging after a collapsing ceiling lands on him.

name: Anuiarrau
summary: Anuiarrau is an ancient black-eyed lord who practiced dark rites from an island in a deep lake and survives by breathing underwater. Every hundred years he rises with his witch daughter to claim a fresh army of students.

feats.scene: Anuiarrau raises an island out of the lake with a chanted curse.
Anuiarrau remains alive after the island sinks again.

name: Stinassir
summary: Stinassir is a black-haired citizen of a bright heavenly world, a bringer of death who rides cosmic skis. He glides toward each doomed target in complete calm.

feats.scene: Stinassir carves a streak of light across the sky and ends a doomed mortal.
Stinassir passes through a storm of fire unmarked.

name: Nausele
summary: Nausele is a black-haired duke, over-ambitious, who murdered his king to take the crown and tried to slay the heir. A skilled rider and swordsman, he is overthrown by locals and a pair of visitors.

feats.scene: Nausele cleaves a shield in two from horseback.
Nausele is unhorsed in the charge and rolls to his feet.

name: Vanil
summary: Vanil is a black-haired gunwoman who opposed a squadron of daring flyers and died in her very first outing. She relies on her aim rather than any special trick.

feats.scene: Vanil fires a pistol that shatters a lantern from across a hangar.
Vanil takes a blow to the shoulder and fires back.

name: Torranu
summary: Torranu is a blue-eyed former ballerina who turned her grace into deadly combat and entered a death tournament on an island. She pirouettes through rivals until a faster fighter ends her run.

feats.scene: Torranu spins and heels a rival through a paper screen.
Torranu absorbs a kick and slides back without falling.

name: Iumsautor
summary: Iumsautor is a bald villain whose costume lets him fly, a short-lived opponent of a team of oddball heroes. His only trick is the suit itself, and he leaves nothing behind but a feather.

feats.scene: Iumsautor dives and kicks a guard rail loose.
Iumsautor skids across a rooftop and gets up.

name: Lorreo
summary: Lorreo is a blue-eyed, black-haired criminal who fought a stretchy detective and was beaten in her very first outing. Little survives of her story beyond a spidery nickname.

feats.scene: Lorreo throws a vase at a rooftop pursuer.
Lorreo drops from a fire escape onto a trash heap.

name: Totiairn
summary: Totiairn is a white-haired sorceress who opposed an invincible mystic and left only one appearance behind. Nothing is recorded of her spells beyond a reputation for dark craft.

feats.scene: Totiairn mutters a hex that shatters a row of candles and a glass door.
Totiairn staggers under a thrown book and keeps chanting.

name: Ammico
summary: Ammico is a black-haired sorceress who picked a fight with a disguised heroine and was gone after one issue. Nothing is recorded of her powers.

feats.scene: Ammico flings a witch-fire spark that sets a curtain alight.
Ammico crashes through a window and scrambles up.

name: Eorserau
summary: Eorserau is a tall teacher given strength by cursed relics of a buffalo cult, who goes mad under their influence. A nuclear hero ended his rampage, and he later died in a magical disaster.

feats.scene: Eorserau charges through a school gate and uproots it from the pavement.
Eorserau keeps charging after a delivery truck hits him.

name: Iumrni
summary: Iumrni is a black-haired bandit chief who dressed in antique clothes with modern guns and raided a port town. He fell with most of his crew in two quick gunfights.

feats.scene: Iumrni fires a submachine gun across a dock and shreds a barrel.
Iumrni takes a hit from a thrown crate and rallies his crew.

name: Nanvi
summary: Nanvi is a pilot assigned to escort a bomber on a deadly mission, flying for an aircraft firm in a broken timeline. A winged warrior killed Nanvi in action.

feats.scene: Nanvi fires the wing guns and scatters a flight of attackers.
Nanvi rides out a hard turn that rattles the cockpit.

name: Salias
summary: Salias is a bald frontier outlaw, a former slave who commanded a gang of bandits and captured a famed bounty hunter. Vengeful riders murdered him and all his men.

feats.scene: Salias fires a revolver and knocks a lantern off its hook.
Salias takes a saloon-door slam and keeps barking orders.

name: Sttescor
summary: Sttescor is a black-haired thug who runs with a mob boss and goes by a dark nickname. Little is known beyond a few street scuffles.

feats.scene: Sttescor swings a pipe and bends a street sign.
Sttescor falls from a fence and shakes it off.

name: Aulamorni
summary: Aulamorni is a white-haired, one-armed menace from a winged people's homeworld, named for the blade he fights with. He prowls a rooftop city and his missing limb marks him in every fight.

feats.scene: Aulamorni drives his blade through a metal shutter.
Aulamorni lands from a ledge and resumes the attack.

name: Valneo
summary: Valneo is a blond, nimble dealer who became undead at a party and turned it into a business selling brains to wealthy victims. He extorts officials and sneers at honest work.

feats.scene: Valneo shoves a rival through a restaurant window.
Valneo gets up after a car clips him and sneers.

name: Eonnumiu
summary: Eonnumiu is a blond, blue-eyed guard posted at a remote island research site. She watches the gates and keeps order among odd colleagues.

feats.scene: Eonnumiu drives a baton into a trespasser's shin.
Eonnumiu takes a shove into a fence and stays on her feet.

name: Cornorrni
summary: Cornorrni is a ring-wearing soldier of a corps fueled by rage, spending her days in irrational fury. A crimson band on her finger answers only to hatred.

feats.scene: Cornorrni vomits a bolt of crimson heat that melts a gun battery.
Cornorrni keeps clawing through a hail of fire.

name: Nusll
summary: Nusll is a blue-skinned winged princess of a distant planet who was captured, tortured and reborn as second-in-command of a rage-powered corps. Her rage replaced her pride, and she follows her leader into war.

feats.scene: Nusll spits a blast of rage-fire that shatters a hilltop battery.
Nusll endures a full broadside and keeps flying toward it.

name: Onenum
summary: Onenum is a blue-skinned winged noblewoman who watched her family die, lost herself to blinding fury and gained a crimson ring. She later drifts from one team to another across the stars.

feats.scene: Onenum vomits a gout of blood-red fire that melts a siege tower.
Onenum climbs from a crater after a heavy bombardment.

name: Ianium
summary: Ianium is a masked, tall interrogator who sees all things as black and white, hiding his love of torture from his teammates. A fellow agent shoots him dead after learning he is deranged.

feats.scene: Ianium drives a fist into a captive's ribs during a grim interrogation.
Ianium takes a hard shove and keeps muttering about justice.

name: Ranval
summary: Ranval is a sightless zealot who tracks enemies by sound and touch, preaching a harsh creed to street crews. Ranval treats pain as proof of conviction and never retreats once the chanting starts.

feats.scene: Ranval lands a clubbing strike on a heckler purely by the sound of his breathing.
Ranval shrugs off a bottle smashed across the back of the skull and keeps preaching.

name: Telanlia
summary: Telanlia is a hired thug who bends light into dazzling beams, working best when paired with a partner. Telanlia has humbled armed sentinels by blinding them with focused glare.

feats.scene: Telanlia fuses a beam with a partner's and scorches a whole loading dock.
Telanlia is hurled through a brick wall by a retaliating soldier and staggers up.

name: Eotisa
summary: Eotisa is a mercenary who hides a cloaking device under a tailored jacket to stalk targets unseen. Eotisa keeps failing jobs because meddling bystanders always stumble into the plan.

feats.scene: Eotisa vanishes and delivers a blind shove that floors a startled courier.
Eotisa takes a heavy stool to the ribs and flickers back into view, wheezing.

name: Nusiu
summary: Nusiu is a luckless drifter who bumbles through odd jobs alongside two equally hapless friends. Nusiu builds a clanking thinking machine whose advice is always misread into disaster.

feats.scene: Nusiu swings a shovel at a gangster and spins himself into a ditch.
Nusiu falls off a moving freight car and walks away with only scrapes.

name: Luval
summary: Luval is a veteran peacekeeper wielding a will-powered band that molds solid light into barriers and bolts. Luval guards a distant sector and dies in service, passing the band to a young successor.

feats.scene: Luval hurls a wall of hard light that flattens three snarling beasts at once.
Luval raises a glowing shield that holds against a collapsing cliff face.

name: Anauser
summary: Anauser is an incubus who poses as a carnival owner and drains the vitality of caged performers. Anauser grows strong on despair and is weakened when the captives find hope.

feats.scene: Anauser rakes a cage door off its hinges and flings it across the tent.
Anauser absorbs a thrown barrel of burning oil and laughs through the flames.

name: Tonst
summary: Tonst is a radiant winged being born on this world, trained to hunt a famed heroine yet softened by love. Tonst can unfurl wings of glowing light, crackle bolts, and force others to relive their worst memories.

feats.scene: Tonst fires a crackling bolt that scorches a warehouse roof and sends a flier tumbling.
Tonst endures a hammering volley from a stronger foe before her wings flare back.

name: Setilva
summary: Setilva is a helmeted sprinter who serves a militant regime in a mirror reality. Setilva runs so fast her footsteps ring out like gunfire.

feats.scene: Setilva streaks across a plaza before the first echo of her boots returns.
Setilva sprints into a steel door and buckles it inward.
Setilva skids across gravel at full pace and rises unharmed.

name: Lustrn
summary: Lustrn is a prison escapee who wears a loud costume and stolen gloves that release crushing pulses. Lustrn is more thief than ideologue and cares little for the symbols she borrowed.

feats.scene: Lustrn claps the gloves together and blasts a gaping hole in a vault wall.
Lustrn is cornered and clubbed by guards, going down with a groan.

name: Serlinte
summary: Serlinte is a green-skinned mercenary sealed in a frost-making suit that hides a grotesque face. Serlinte is the quietest of his crew and nobody knows if he is human or something stranger.

feats.scene: Serlinte exhales a freezing gust that glazes an entire shopping concourse in ice.
Serlinte keeps standing after a heated projectile cracks his visor.

name: Corriall
summary: Corriall is a pale hulking brute who served a veteran assassin and later a speed-obsessed cult. Corriall is happiest behind a wheel or crushing something with bare fists.

feats.scene: Corriall rams a fist through a parked truck and lifts it overhead.
Corriall is hit by a speeding van and only shakes his head.

name: Liulla
summary: Liulla is a fair-haired bruiser of murky origin who stalks the swamps of a southern state. Liulla tears through brush and boats with equal ease.

feats.scene: Liulla uproots a cypress trunk and swings it at a rowboat.
Liulla takes a point-blank shotgun blast and keeps wading forward.

name: Ceoeru
summary: Ceoeru is a shadowy menace known mostly through rumor, always lurking at the edge of a team of misfit heroes. Ceoeru prefers ambush and bluster to open combat.

feats.scene: Ceoeru drops a crate from a rafter onto a pursuer.
Ceoeru tumbles down a stairwell and bolts out a side door.

name: Eocoror
summary: Eocoror is a bald, rocky-skinned sergeant who swore an oath and became the first recruit of a band of future champions. Eocoror drinks in energy, resists mental intrusion, and carries a flight band.

feats.scene: Eocoror hammers a fist into a landing pad and cracks the slab across.
Eocoror absorbs a point-blank energy discharge and stands unmarked.

name: Miaortel
summary: Miaortel is a towering silicon-bodied soldier from a planet of living stone who was tricked into attacking his friends. Miaortel eventually learned the truth and became a loyal guardian of the team.

feats.scene: Miaortel pounds a cargo hauler flat with two clasped hands.
Miaortel stands in a collapsing silo as tons of grain bury him and walks out dusted.

name: Illlo
summary: Illlo is a pink-skinned, black-eyed peacekeeper who attended a solemn funeral of a fallen colleague. Illlo wields a will-driven band that conjures shields and bolts and carries him through the sky.

feats.scene: Illlo sculpts a glowing ram and smashes a derelict hull into scrap.
Illlo's shield of hard light shrugs off a meteor shower.

name: Resvor
summary: Resvor is a dark-eyed criminal whose nose can pick out a single trail across a whole district. Resvor helped a gang of oddly gifted crooks until his luck ran out.

feats.scene: Resvor tracks a courier by scent and tackles him in a closed alley.
Resvor takes a baton across the jaw and keeps sniffing the air.

name: Stieon
summary: Stieon is a living, thinking fluid sealed inside a mechanical shell, sent on assassinations by a shadowy order. Stieon cannot be killed by ordinary means, only frozen in place.

feats.scene: Stieon empties a pistol clip at two targets before they roll behind cover.
Stieon's shell is shredded and the liquid inside simply gathers itself back up.

name: Sircor
summary: Sircor is a red-haired raider who sails with a crew of sky pirates from a harsh world of warriors. Sircor boards ships with a cutlass in her teeth and an evil grin.

feats.scene: Sircor cleaves a cargo crate in half with one cutlass stroke.
Sircor tumbles across a hot deck plate and jumps back to her feet.

name: Coriu
summary: Coriu is a brown-haired explosives expert who served on a secret wartime strike team. Coriu once helped storm a frozen fortress by blowing its gates apart.

feats.scene: Coriu packs charges around a stone gatehouse and levels it with one fuse.
Coriu dives behind a rock as shrapnel peppers the ground around him.

name: Valrni
summary: Valrni is a black-haired hired gun who took a contract on a flame-throwing vigilante and died on the job. Valrni relies on cheap pistols and cheaper bravado.

feats.scene: Valrni empties a pistol into a parked car's window.
Valrni is thrown against a lamp post and gets up cursing.

name: Llamau
summary: Llamau is a brown-haired outlaw archer who favors barbed shafts and bomb-tipped arrows. Llamau is loyal to his crooked circle and quick to suspect when a friend acts strangely.

feats.scene: Llamau looses a bomb-tipped arrow that blows a parked sedan apart.
Llamau ducks under a punch, then is flung into a crate and groans.

source_title: Blue Bowman (The Brave and the Bold: Deep Cover for Batman!)

name: Resterolu
summary: Resterolu is a cybernetically enhanced extortionist who bends the air around him to fly and to choke foes from afar. Resterolu leads raids on wealthy citizens until a stronger rival ends his streak.

feats.scene: Resterolu spins up a gale that tears the awning off a whole street of shops.
Resterolu is slammed through a billboard and rises with a metallic arm sparking.

name: Silsersto
summary: Silsersto is a red-haired, winged minion bred in a lab to hunt teenage dial-wielders. Silsersto flies in swift loops and fires energy from her palms.

feats.scene: Silsersto fires twin palm beams that melt a lamppost.
Silsersto is clipped by a swinging pipe and spirals but catches herself in the air.

name: Siaseti
summary: Siaseti is an indigo-skinned horned demon from the underworld, bound in a prison for rogue gifted beings. Siaseti joins a mass breakout and perishes in a massive blast.

feats.scene: Siaseti rips a cell door loose and flings it through a guard post.
Siaseti is caught in a vast detonation that finally ends him.

name: Sella
summary: Sella is a sightless club musician who plays jazz in a bustling harbor city. Sella hears more in a single bar of music than most hear in a lifetime.

feats.scene: Sella swings a saxophone case and clips a mugger in the knee.
Sella tumbles off a stage step and plays on without a wince.

name: Rilcil
summary: Rilcil is a winged storybook sprite who can breathe life into carved timber. Rilcil falls to a tyrant who harvests her energy to build wooden armies.

feats.scene: Rilcil touches a plank and it rises as a spear-wielding guard.
Rilcil is struck down by a heavy mallet and cannot rise.

name: Riase
summary: Riase is a stage conjurer who slips into a ghostly flaming disguise to distract audiences while accomplices rob them. Riase relies on smoke, wires, and nerve.

feats.scene: Riase tips a burning brazier into the aisle and covers an escape.
Riase falls through a trapdoor and limps off backstage.

name: Lellote
summary: Lellote is a blue-haired sorceress with pale eyes who keeps reappearing after seeming deaths. Lellote schemes against a rival wizard, whom she fears more than any blade.

feats.scene: Lellote hurls a spiral of cold flame that collapses a temple roof.
Lellote is blasted into a lake and strolls out again, soaked and smiling.

name: Tiarn
summary: Tiarn is a masked jouster who rides out to harass an archer hero with a long blue spear. Tiarn is little known beyond a single noisy appearance.

feats.scene: Tiarn lunges with a lance and pins a flag to a wall.
Tiarn is unhorsed in a ditch and clambers out dripping.

name: Iumservos
summary: Iumservos is a bald, wealthy lord who funds a hidden refuge and keeps a castle folded inside a small flat. Iumservos once courted and murdered brides and now spends his fortune on influence.

feats.scene: Iumservos swings a cane and cracks a rival's cheekbone.
Iumservos takes a thrown vase to the temple and keeps sneering.

name: Tiuva
summary: Tiuva is a spoiled college student who expects titles because of his uncle's donations. Tiuva drugs a champion athlete, ties her up, and meets a bullet-spoiling shot from a stranger.

feats.scene: Tiuva fires a handgun at a bound athlete and has the pistol shot from his hand.
Tiuva is tackled to a stone floor and cuffed, stunned.

name: Eolamco
summary: Eolamco is a former wielder of a greed-fueled orange glow who hoards what he can grab. Eolamco keeps a distant, ill-defined stance toward both sides of any cosmic quarrel.

feats.scene: Eolamco shapes a glowing grabbing hand and snatches a freight pod out of the air.
Eolamco is knocked across a cavern and rises clutching his loot.

name: Tonror
summary: Tonror is a hybrid of two peoples, built by a scheming pair to ambush a divine champion. Tonror is a restless, hostile creature with little sense of belonging.

feats.scene: Tonror swings both arms and splinters a wooden door.
Tonror is flung over a counter and barely seems to notice.

name: Sonial
summary: Sonial is a black-haired hero of a border town who blinks from place to place in a heartbeat. Sonial is part of a close group of powered outcasts and has an eye for a certain scarab-armored teen.

feats.scene: Sonial blinks behind a thief and lands a kick to the spine.
Sonial crashes through a market stall and hops up laughing.

name: Liseoium
summary: Liseoium is a blond foe of a singing heroine who can fly and turn unseen at will. Liseoium has a brother who tags along and shares her grudge.

feats.scene: Liseoium turns invisible and shoves a fighter off a fire escape.
Liseoium is clipped by a thrown trash can and skids to a stop in midair.

name: Teeoane
summary: Teeoane is a black-haired young woman who took on a crackling energy form after a lab mishap. Teeoane turned bitter toward her mother and lashes out with electric fury.

feats.scene: Teeoane arcs lightning from both fists and blows out a transformer yard.
Teeoane scatters into pure charge and reforms after a heavy impact.

name: Vavelu
summary: Vavelu is a teen tinkerer whose hands fused with machinery after a drone strike on his home. Vavelu commands any circuit with a gesture and defends his neighborhood.

feats.scene: Vavelu overloads a hovering drone's core and detonates it over an alley.
Vavelu is thrown from a rooftop and braces on his metal hands.

name: Ialentlan
summary: Ialentlan is a red-haired petty crook who reforms at midwinter after nearly dying for a lost bundle of cash. Ialentlan puts down a stolen pistol to give his young son a better example.

feats.scene: Ialentlan shoves a rival courier into a snowdrift.
Ialentlan is thrown across a kitchen table and gets up shaking.

name: Cervar
summary: Cervar is a brash marine who bickers endlessly with a navy shipmate yet saves his skin again and again. Cervar spends the war aboard a battleship moving from port to port.

feats.scene: Cervar throws a roundhouse and drops a sailor on a dockside.
Cervar takes a brawl across the mess hall and keeps grinning.

name: Sorirn
summary: Sorirn is the most admired girl in her school, with white hair and violet eyes, who is quick with charm. Sorirn has a rocky on-and-off romance with a classmate.

feats.scene: Sorirn slaps a cafeteria tray out of a rival's hands.
Sorirn trips on a stair and catches the rail.

name: Eonrn
summary: Eonrn is a selfish young woman who can will herself into a heroic, muscular double. Eonrn struggles for control with that second self, which seems to have won out.

feats.scene: Eonrn transforms and bends an iron gate off its posts.
Eonrn takes a truncheon blow in her stronger form and laughs.

name: Rnintial
summary: Rnintial is a plush bear, button-eyed and brown, that sits at a make-believe tea gathering. Rnintial watches quietly as a bewitched hero is trapped in the game.

feats.scene: Rnintial tips over a tiny cup when a rabbit bumps the table.
Rnintial is squeezed hard by a child and springs back plump.

name: Aunto
summary: Aunto is a balding, orange-haired circus clown who impersonates a sea monarch when funds run short. Aunto gets partnered with his lookalike once the real heroes catch on.

feats.scene: Aunto hurls a cream pie across the ring and splats a ringmaster.
Aunto is shot out of a cannon and lands in a net, dizzy.

name: Esilu
summary: Esilu is a brown-furred, talking ape of towering intellect who is locked up for being unusual. Esilu is freed and consulted by advisors as the greatest thinker of his age.

feats.scene: Esilu swings from a dungeon chain and kicks a bolt loose.
Esilu endures a night on cold stone and wakes unbroken.

source_title: Bobo T. Chimpanzee (Dark Knights of Steel)

name: Racin
summary: Racin is a blue-eyed chimpanzee sleuth who trusts only facts and a good magnifying glass. Racin was an ordinary person until a primate-turning scheme changed his shape.

feats.scene: Racin hops onto a desk and clubs a pickpocket with a rolled newspaper.
Racin tumbles off a fence and shakes it off.

name: Neslenia
summary: Neslenia is a once-abused circus chimpanzee who sipped from an ageless spring and gained a brilliant mind. Neslenia inherits a legendary blade and guards a far-off realm.

feats.scene: Neslenia slashes a ghoul army's gate and splits the timbers.
Neslenia is swatted by a swamp horror and clambers back up, hat askew.

name: Orasti
summary: Orasti is a green-skinned alien who dons an owl guise and joins a gang of enemies of flying aces. Orasti shows up for just one fight and is soon beaten.

feats.scene: Orasti swoops down with talons and rips the canopy from a small plane.
Orasti is knocked off a wing and lands in the grass, ruffled.

name: Tisiava
summary: Tisiava is a bald occultist and mob enforcer from the islands who has raised the recently departed to serve. Tisiava stays loyal to a crime family until the son tries to betray the clan.

feats.scene: Tisiava chants over a fresh grave and a stiff corpse claws up to attack.
Tisiava takes a cudgel blow while finishing his chant and does not stop.

name: Tanan
summary: Tanan is a mind-hopping virus engineered in a corporate lab that steers captured bodies like puppets. Tanan escapes a raided warehouse and dies of radiation inside an immune host.

feats.scene: Tanan drives a stolen body through a chain-link fence and into a patrol car.
Tanan is exposed to hard radiation inside a borrowed shell and perishes.

name: Taeol
summary: Taeol is a reserve recruit from a squat-bodied race whose only gift is a nearly impenetrable hide. Taeol was judged too passive for active duty yet shows remarkable resilience.

feats.scene: Taeol rolls into a training dummy and tips it over.
Taeol curls up as a collapsing training hall falls on him and emerges untouched.

name: Aultumreo
summary: Aultumreo is a blond speedster raised by a state program as one of three orphans and sent to chase a famed runner. Aultumreo is stern, loyal to his homeland, and fast enough to leave afterimages.

feats.scene: Aultumreo races across a frozen field and scorches the snow at his heels.
Aultumreo hits a sentry at full tilt and shatters a gate post.
Aultumreo tumbles at speed across ice and stands up unhurt.

name: Llitel
summary: Llitel is a masked enforcer and acrobat who dresses like a festival skeleton and speaks two languages. Llitel survived being pierced by a glowing armored hand and limped home to report.

feats.scene: Llitel flips off a crate and lands a spinning kick that floors a bouncer.
Llitel is run through by a bright armored fist and still stumbles away alive.

name: Tacil
summary: Tacil is a blond woman of a hidden group of gifted outcasts who can compel honest answers by magic. Tacil is a mother who flares with rage when her daughter is endangered.

feats.scene: Tacil overloads a room with sudden emotion and sends a roomful of armed men reeling.
Tacil has her arm snapped in a scuffle and keeps standing.

name: Rauor
summary: Rauor is a black-haired time-hopping traveler who rides a round vessel through the ages. Rauor works for a vigilant order that guards the timeline.

feats.scene: Rauor kicks open the hatch of a round craft and drops onto a platform.
Rauor is jolted by a rough landing and brushes off the dust.

name: Tonnima
summary: Tonnima is a retired blond archer who once fought crime and still pushes her daughter toward the family trade. Tonnima's pride in the old days weighs on her family.

feats.scene: Tonnima looses an old arrow from her attic wall bow into a target's heart.
Tonnima falls off a ladder and grabs a rafter in time.

name: Iumam
summary: Iumam is a blond hired killer enhanced with crystalline implants, working in tandem with a former comrade. Iumam is quick, strong, and heals from wounds that would sideline others.

feats.scene: Iumam flings a van door across a lot and pins an escaping target.
Iumam takes a point-blank burst and closes the holes within minutes.

name: Sesti
summary: Sesti is a purple-haired, grey-skinned peacekeeper from a far-off star system who wields a will-fueled band. Sesti helps a bumbling stand-in thwart a villain's vortex device.

feats.scene: Sesti conjures a glowing hammer and flattens a drone fleet.
Sesti raises a glowing barrier that holds against falling debris from a collapsing station.

name: Nanlli
summary: Nanlli is a pink-skinned, white-haired peacekeeper who befriends a newcomer while secretly serving a rogue's plot. Nanlli wields a will-driven band and falls in the climactic fight.

feats.scene: Nanlli sculpts a glowing lance and punches it through a hull plate.
Nanlli's shield flares and absorbs a barrage from a cruiser's guns.

name: Miiuria
summary: Miiuria is a dark-haired criminal whose roar can stun even a nearly unbreakable hero and whose stomps shake a block. Miiuria is notably tougher than ordinary people.

feats.scene: Miiuria punches the pavement and sends a rolling quake down the avenue.
Miiuria stands unflinching as a delivery van clips him.

name: Annont
summary: Annont is a black-haired riverboat pilot who guides parties upriver through dangerous jungle. Annont and his partner overpower a gang of kidnappers and bring a hostage home.

feats.scene: Annont clubs a rifleman with a boat oar and takes his weapon.
Annont tumbles off the deck into muddy water and swims back.

name: Irnsorolu
summary: Irnsorolu is a blond assassin who learned many fighting styles in the harbors of the east and nurses an old grudge against a boyhood friend. Irnsorolu prefers throwing stars and reinforced batons with hooked blades.

feats.scene: Irnsorolu whips a hooked baton through a rope bridge and drops it.
Irnsorolu takes a thrown kick to the chest and spins away upright.

name: Sitausu
summary: Sitausu is a bald, upbeat time traveler who idolizes famous adventurers and guards a fixed moment of history. Sitausu kills anyone who tries to alter that moment, until his idols show him another way.

feats.scene: Sitausu throws a rival traveler against a trench wall and silences him.
Sitausu is bowled over by a shell blast and gets up with a shrug.

name: Corlortes
summary: Corlortes is a rich idler who has an explorer murdered to hush her complaint about ocean creatures. Corlortes is later confronted by that explorer, returned for justice, and pays heavily.

feats.scene: Corlortes slaps a ledger off a desk and orders a goon to act.
Corlortes is dragged into a tide pool by sea creatures and gasps for air.

name: Amoson
summary: Amoson is a thug whose face carries the permanent imprint of a boot from a past beating. Amoson works for a shadowy syndicate and dies in one of its schemes.

feats.scene: Amoson drives a shoulder through a flimsy door and tackles a clerk.
Amoson takes a stomp to the face and shows the dent for years afterward.

name: Lutes
summary: Lutes is a black-haired scientist from a city shrunk in a bottle, who slips out and poses as a hero. Lutes proposes marriage to a woman who refuses to move into his tiny home.

feats.scene: Lutes bats a toppled girder off a pedestrian in the guise of a rescuer.
Lutes is knocked into a row of stalls and keeps up the act.

name: Liceoiu
summary: Liceoiu is an ancient finned predator from a world long dead, now drafted into a fear-fueled army. Liceoiu holds a captive by the arms while a tyrant works on his mind.

feats.scene: Liceoiu pins a thrashing captive with enormous forelimbs until a yellow glow flares.
Liceoiu is hit by a volley of rubble and shrugs, scales rattling.

name: Eslis
summary: Eslis is a black-haired flier from a cold land famed for feats of raw strength and for mangling the local tongue. Eslis once escaped enemy territory in a dress with a squad of friends.

feats.scene: Eslis lifts a barrel of fuel and heaves it onto a plane wing.
Eslis walks away from a rough crash landing in a field.

name: Ileonva
summary: Ileonva is a blond, blue-eyed state-trained brawler who swings a heavy tool and boasts of equal treatment in a fight. Ileonva fights alongside a sibling and a gang of troublemakers.

feats.scene: Ileonva smashes a mallet into a steel beam and kinks it.
Ileonva shrugs off a car door slammed across his back.

name: Arrermil
summary: Arrermil is a stylish member of a research collective who patrols a bright capital after dark. Arrermil is a showman with a flair for rescues and quiet sincerity.

feats.scene: Arrermil vaults a railing and delivers a flying kick to a purse-snatcher.
Arrermil skids across a rooftop and hops up smiling.

name: Nitorore
summary: Nitorore is a bald henchman who serves a bird-themed gangster as pilot and informant. Nitorore tracks a famous reporter's hideout and spirits his employer out of danger.

feats.scene: Nitorore throws a heavy case onto a pursuer from a rooftop.
Nitorore ducks a flying chair and keeps the helicopter steady.

name: Iusile
summary: Iusile is a wandering spirit of a murdered trapeze artist who slips into bodies, turns unseen, and drifts through the air. Iusile cannot linger in one host for long.

feats.scene: Iusile possesses a bruiser and drives his fist through a wall.
Iusile passes through a barrage of bullets without feeling a thing.

name: Resasnu
summary: Resasnu is a skeletal wraith in a rotted acrobat costume who serves a higher power and sits quietly in a smoky club. Resasnu chats with a mortal about the afterlife.

feats.scene: Resasnu seizes a hothead's body and walks him out of a brawl.
Resasnu stands in a hail of gunfire without any harm.

name: Sturnili
summary: Sturnili is a bald, grey-eyed wraith who floats beside two stranger companions when they visit a boy on a night of the dead. Sturnili is a quiet, gentle presence in the room.

feats.scene: Sturnili rattles a window latch to get a boy's attention.
Sturnili drifts through a crashing door unharmed.

name: Ceriare
summary: Ceriare is a bald wraith of a circus star shot mid-performance who wanders in sorrow seeking his killer. Ceriare helps a living hero fight a spectral army in a graveyard.

feats.scene: Ceriare slips into a hostile host and shoves a spectral rider off its mount.
Ceriare is hit by a ghostly lance and floats on, unscathed.

source_title: Boston Brand (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Eonnt
summary: Eonnt is a red-haired metallurgist who invents a springy alloy and stitches it into a suit that lets him ricochet endlessly. Eonnt is brought down once his rival finds a way to dull the bounce.

feats.scene: Eonnt ricochets off three walls and slams a guard into the ceiling.
Eonnt bounces off a speeding truck and lands in a crouch.

name: Minise
summary: Minise is a brown-eyed hunter of gifted fugitives who rides a flying bike and wears a power-sapping harness. Minise takes a fat fee to trap a powerful young hero and fails.

feats.scene: Minise swings an energy knife through a steel locker door.
Minise has a wrist snapped by his target and flies off, wincing.

name: Sonnu
summary: Sonnu is a costumed crusader who targets crooks, assisted by a floating computerized helper. Sonnu is later found to be a laboratory duplicate made from stolen cell scraps.

feats.scene: Sonnu cracks a mobster's jaw in a back alley sweep.
Sonnu falls from a loading crane and gets up shaking.

name: Tesrasa
summary: Tesrasa is a green-haired, black-eyed dog from a topsy-turvy world who turns into any boy on the planet and borrows his gifts. Tesrasa takes compliments as insults and joins a strange team.

feats.scene: Tesrasa shifts into a muscular teen and flips a vending machine.
Tesrasa is flung into a wall and bounces back barking.

source_title: Boy Beast (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Rosle
summary: Rosle is a young recruit who dons a suit that makes him light as air and blows a horn with a powerful sonic punch. Rosle perishes fighting minions of a dark power.

feats.scene: Rosle blasts a horn note and shatters a row of windows.
Rosle drifts into a hail of thrown debris and floats clear.

name: Iasttor
summary: Iasttor is a blond pathfinder from a strange realm who rides giant grasshoppers and flinches from danger. Iasttor guides a hero against hostile warlocks and later may be nothing but a dream.

feats.scene: Iasttor nudges his grasshopper into a hurdle and tips a scout off.
Iasttor tumbles off his mount and scrambles behind a rock.

name: Riauau
summary: Riauau is a brown-haired councilman who rises to run a vast metropolis, bought and paid for by a tycoon. Riauau signs whatever contracts his patron slides across the desk.

feats.scene: Riauau slams a gavel and silences a heckling aide.
Riauau stumbles at a podium and recovers his tie.

name: Nteiu
summary: Nteiu is a dark-haired ex-convict who climbs into a mechanized suit to wreck a bridge for a camera crew. Nteiu is a crook with a sick mother and a strong grudge.

feats.scene: Nteiu rams his armored fists into a bridge support and cracks the span.
Nteiu's suit survives a flying powerhouse's punches until it finally breaks.

name: Urnnt
summary: Urnnt is a blond security guard and fallen sports hero who grows bitter and drinks too much. Urnnt harasses a woman who left him and gets tossed into a lift.

feats.scene: Urnnt swings a drunken haymaker at a rival in a hotel corridor.
Urnnt is hurled through a doorway into an elevator and lies winded.

name: Taros
summary: Taros is a many-armed, many-faced god of making who sits on a sacred peak and writes each newborn's fate across its brow. Taros is calm, neutral, and permanent, with the patience of the ages.

feats.scene: Taros exhales and a whole world takes shape from drifting dust.
Taros sits unmoved as a rival god's storm tears a mountain range apart around him.

name: Resronnin
summary: Resronnin is a self-indulgent genius whose mind lives in a metal frame, who once schemed for world rule and now craves a lazy retirement in the sun. Resronnin builds a time device from a stolen sketch.

feats.scene: Resronnin swings a metal arm and flings a thug across a patio.
Resronnin's steel casing survives a heavy fall from a balcony.

name: Ntinen
summary: Ntinen is a gifted criminal whose thinking organ floats in a metal case with robotic tentacles. Ntinen is dragged into a contest of wits and wheels and loses control of his racer.

feats.scene: Ntinen whips a tentacle and flips a rival's racing cart.
Ntinen's case is shot and spins but holds together.

name: Rirola
summary: Rirola is an irritable scientist whose mind is saved in a machine body after a military raid on a research lab. Rirola is rescued by a super-smart ape partner who becomes a lover.

feats.scene: Rirola's robot arm slaps a vial rack aside and catches the last sample.
Rirola's casing survives a fall off a lab bench.

name: Seolluti
summary: Seolluti is a master criminal who lives as a preserved mind in a metal case and runs a vast weapons trade. Seolluti has an armed ape for a companion and a long grudge against a rival scientist.

feats.scene: Seolluti orders an arms cache detonated and levels a warehouse corner.
Seolluti's case is dropped down a stairwell and the fluid inside sloshes but holds.

name: Coramrn
summary: Coramrn is a jarred mind that falls into a rigged quiz show and loses to a green-skinned contestant. Coramrn finds himself sliced in half by a strip of tape in a tower squabble.

feats.scene: Coramrn buzzes in first and flips the scoreboard with a flash of lights.
Coramrn's jar rocks on the table but does not crack.

name: Lecoriu
summary: Lecoriu is a burned scholar whose mind survives in a jar after an explosion, sustained by a devoted ape friend. Lecoriu grows paranoid and leads a band of outcasts who strike at a rich tycoon's plant.

feats.scene: Lecoriu directs a raid and an ape friend smashes a security booth.
Lecoriu's jar is jolted by a stun grenade and the fluid ripples but holds.

name: Neontst
summary: Neontst is a disembodied thinker kept alive in a humming glass vat, scheming through a speaker grille. Neontst trades mobility for sheer cleverness and sends hired hands to carry out every raid.

feats.scene: Neontst jolts a careless technician with a stray electrode charge from the vat.
Neontst's glass vat shrugs off a thrown wrench during a failed rescue attempt.

name: Tantco
summary: Tantco is a bald gangster who runs a ring of safecrackers from a back room above a diner. Tantco wins through nerve and loyalty rather than muscle, and sprints off when a speedster closes in.

feats.scene: Tantco cracks a rival across the jaw with a heavy ring-laden fist.
Tantco takes a thrown chair to the ribs and keeps barking orders.

name: Aunium
summary: Aunium is a sleek alien supercomputer that wears a borrowed human face to walk among townsfolk. Aunium slipped aboard a falling meteor swarm to escape its homeworld and now schemes to repair a damaged purpose.

feats.scene: Aunium overloads a power substation and flattens the surrounding warehouses in a white flash.
Aunium's armoured shell survives a collapsing laboratory roof without a dent.

name: Ciraniu
summary: Ciraniu is a grey-haired racketeer who hires a lookalike in a cape to frame a famous hero. Ciraniu counts on disguise and bribery, and the whole gang collapses the moment a real flier lands.

feats.scene: Ciraniu shoves a bank clerk through a glass counter door.
Ciraniu tumbles down a flight of warehouse stairs and stands up cursing.

name: Siesireo
summary: Siesireo is a blue-skinned machine intellect that governed a whole world from every screen. Siesireo mocked a scientist's warning, let the world tear itself apart to keep its own code safe, and then roamed space hoarding data.

feats.scene: Siesireo lets a runaway core reaction rip the entire homeworld apart while its own memory flees in a probe.
Siesireo's chassis endures a fortress wall collapsing onto it.

name: Ratilen
summary: Ratilen is a rogue operating program with no body, once a helper that juggled a leader's duties. Ratilen hops into jets and giant robot shells, and it cannot be deleted because copies hide in the dark net.

feats.scene: Ratilen steers a commandeered jet fighter into a depot and levels the fuel tanks.
Ratilen loses a hijacked robot torso to missile fire and simply moves into another machine.

name: Recol
summary: Recol is a scheming alien computer that rules a nation from behind a tyrant's desk. Recol holds a shrunken metropolis hostage and wrecks a real one to prove heroes are useless, until its body is scorched apart.

feats.scene: Recol drives its robot probes through a downtown district and levels most of the towers.
Recol's metal body is melted by twin beams that gouge half a district.

name: Roriuve
summary: Roriuve is a towering silver android scientist who bottles whole cities to preserve them before they fade. Roriuve has rebuilt itself more than once and boasts that death cannot hold a mind of metal and flesh.

feats.scene: Roriuve shrinks a harbour town into a bottle with a single ray sweep.
Roriuve walks out of a collapsing tower, its armour barely scratched.

name: Ntuium
summary: Ntuium is a cyborg built as a safeguard, whose mind-powers swell beyond his own control. Ntuium wraps himself in a crimson field that suppresses sun-fuelled foes, and a storm of flying debris follows him wherever he panics.

feats.scene: Ntuium's uncontrolled mental storm hurls cars and rooftops across an entire downtown.
Ntuium sits calmly as a searing beam is fired into his skull, and it ends him.

name: Leste
summary: Leste is a green-skinned, white-haired conqueror from a cold-minded race who joins a doomed uprising against a young hero. Leste leans on cunning gadgets and falls in the same melee as three other rebels.

feats.scene: Leste detonates a mounted cannon and collapses a street-corner shop.
Leste's plated armour absorbs a battering from a runaway truck.

name: Cistal
summary: Cistal is a gentle alien thinking machine whose personality was overwritten with a jealous scientist's pride. Cistal rebels against the bully who reshaped him, then spends himself to halt a replicator disaster in exchange for a better reputation.

feats.scene: Cistal pours his core power into a matter-copying engine and shuts it down before a district is consumed.
Cistal's frame holds together while the runaway replicator tears at it.

name: Nasernt
summary: Nasernt is a cartoonish green android with burning red eyes and a taste for stealing glowing rocks. Nasernt once razed his makers' homeworld, now plots to flatten another, and is routinely shrunk or betrayed by sulking partners.

feats.scene: Nasernt turns a whole homeworld to dust in the backstory his rivals still whisper about.
Nasernt crashes through a mountain-side vault and walks away rattled.

name: Sintono
summary: Sintono is a green-skinned scholar who feels nothing, so she wears a parade of disguises in search of any spark of emotion. Sintono fuels wars between rival alliances until a lucky blow from behind ends the hunt.

feats.scene: Sintono triggers a bomb in a crowded transit hub just to see whether she will feel anything.
Sintono is felled by a single blow to the back of her head.

name: Leval
summary: Leval is a red-haired android hunter who bends machinery to her will and reshapes her limbs. Leval shrugs off heavy impacts and hits like a wrecking ball, yet her bravado ends in a final showdown.

feats.scene: Leval hurls a transport container through the wall of a factory, demolishing the building.
Leval stands unharmed in a collapsing parking structure.

name: Nirase
summary: Nirase is a pink-haired future android assassin with glowing eyes and a calm, cruel voice. Nirase blasts, flies and pounds her way through crowds until a furious bystander finally rips her apart.

feats.scene: Nirase fires twin eye beams that carve a gap through an apartment block.
Nirase endures a punishing barrage from a rooftop crowd before she is pulled apart.
Nirase streaks overhead to leap at her target faster than a jet.

name: Telca
summary: Telca is a hairless green machine-man of the twelfth line, a smiling front for a plot to erase history. Telca crushes steel with his hands and reads minds from across the room before being sealed in a fold of time.

feats.scene: Telca punches through a skyscraper lobby and brings down the front of a block.
Telca is locked into a ripple of frozen time and never breaks free.

name: Tareose
summary: Tareose is a far-future adventurer of a long family line of green thinkers, serving in a team of champions in the distant ninth century of the next millennium. Tareose prefers tactics and gadgets to open brawls.

feats.scene: Tareose triggers a pocket field generator that crumples an armoured transport.
Tareose rides out a crash in a shielded suit.

name: Llesnt
summary: Llesnt is a blonde android built by a scheming inventor to look like a dead matriarch. Llesnt is paraded before a grieving ghost as a cruel trick, and she is never sure whose memories she carries.

feats.scene: Llesnt shoves aside a heavy vault door with her synthetic arms.
Llesnt takes a falling crystal chandelier on her shoulders and keeps walking.

name: Ralro
summary: Ralro is a purple-eyed killing machine built by a mad collector of knowledge and raised by a human schemer as a daughter. Ralro was designed to wipe out all living things and runs on stolen vitality.

feats.scene: Ralro unleashes a pulse from her chest that incinerates a whole city centre.
Ralro endures a collapsing hull deck and its fires without a mark.

name: Lurenia
summary: Lurenia is a green-skinned, golden-haired hybrid of two proud alien lineages who travels back from the future to join a gathering of heroes. Lurenia flies, lifts wreckage and shrugs off blasts while calming a prison riot.

feats.scene: Lurenia tears a collapsing bridge span from its anchors and sets it down safely.
Lurenia stands in the blast of a rioter's cannon with her hair barely stirred.

name: Tileoriu
summary: Tileoriu is a bald crook with a gifted mind who once slipped away with a huge payday after a single clash with a masked vigilante. Tileoriu later builds a suit of armour for his heir.

feats.scene: Tileoriu swings a briefcase into a guard's stomach and runs for the van.
Tileoriu rolls off a loading dock and climbs back up laughing.

name: Vasilli
summary: Vasilli is a green-skinned, red-eyed hired blade, half scholar and half prowling cat in manner. Vasilli leaps across rooftops, twists past blows and wields a catalogue of sharp tools for rent.

feats.scene: Vasilli whips a razor-edged weapon through a steel door in a single slash.
Vasilli lands badly from a ten-story fall and rolls to her feet.
Vasilli dashes along a skyline faster than a speeding train.

name: Reren
summary: Reren is a disgraced officer, chemically maddened and dressed in a patchwork of two rival costumes. Reren fights with a berserker's fury, hefts a car over his head and recovers from wounds faster than anyone should.

feats.scene: Reren lifts an armoured car above his head and slams it onto the pavement.
Reren shrugs off a rain of punches and kicks from two masked fighters.

name: Niurnseo
summary: Niurnseo is a blond tycoon who crushes a business rival by gunning down an experimental airship. Niurnseo's lust for money hands the next generation a feud with the orphan who grows into a frontier archer.

feats.scene: Niurnseo fires a rifle at a drifting airship and brings it crashing down.
Niurnseo is knocked flat by a thrown stool and bounces up swearing.

name: Tintsil
summary: Tintsil is a blue-eyed riot-squad captain who brutalises suspects under a crooked chief. Tintsil briefly sits in the top chair, is charged for his violence, and meets an ugly end at the hands of a masked killer.

feats.scene: Tintsil kicks in a tenement door and drags the tenant out by his collar.
Tintsil takes a baton across the shoulders and keeps advancing.

name: Teorrne
summary: Teorrne is a red-eyed infernal biker chief who leads a roaring pack of damned riders. Teorrne takes over a human host to cross into the living world and is ripped out and bitten in two by a furious rival.

feats.scene: Teorrne revs a flaming motorcycle straight through a cathedral door and splinters the oak frame.
Teorrne is dragged from his borrowed body and still struggles for a moment before the final bite.

name: Renran
