Erusauil takes a hard fall onto concrete and shakes it off.

name: Rilucel
summary: Rilucel is a white-haired, yellow-skinned smuggler from a matriarchal world who swaps weight between people and objects. Rilucel can turn herself ghostly, once humiliated an invading army by making their uniforms drift away, and loves a particular fermented drink.

feats.scene: Rilucel makes a guard's rifle heavy as an anvil so he can only drop it.
Rilucel turns intangible and lets a hail of shots pass harmlessly through her.

name: Rnurn
summary: Rnurn is a flag-waving costumed crusader from a small island nation who dresses like a loyal hound. Rnurn keeps a secret identity, throws a mean tackle and takes pride in defending ordinary streets.

feats.scene: Rnurn tackles a bag thief at full sprint and pins him to the pavement.
Rnurn rolls from a speeding bus and gets up shaking his fist.

name: Naamo
summary: Naamo is a blonde government spy who spends her days acting out the part of a wicked outlaw. Naamo secretly reports to a hidden agency and relies on charm and a convincing mask rather than force.

feats.scene: Naamo slaps a nosy colleague to keep her cover intact.
Naamo takes a hard shove from a teammate and plays the victim.

name: Eruoreora
summary: Eruoreora is a gentle, black-eyed missionary whose devotion to hope fuels a ring that never needs recharging. Eruoreora left a dying homeworld behind, now fights with a ring of shimmering blue light and can strengthen allies' own rings with sheer optimism.

feats.scene: Eruoreora weaves a blue beam wide enough to rip a freighter apart.
Eruoreora walks through a barrage while calmly assuring his foes that all will be well.

name: Eslesaun
summary: Eslesaun is a hairless, serene envoy who appears briefly to reassure two humans that their troubles will pass. Eslesaun carries a ring of blue light for blasts and flight, and he falls shortly after speaking.

feats.scene: Eslesaun hurls a hard blue lance from his ring and shatters a stone arch.
Eslesaun is struck down after his calm warning is delivered.

name: Anrer
summary: Anrer is a bald convict spared from the electric chair by a sinister preacher who gave him a purple stone-like hide. Anrer hurls cars, smashes through barriers and street surfaces, and fights until the shell finally cracks away.

feats.scene: Anrer throws a sedan through a shop window and tears a crater in the road behind it.
Anrer takes repeated blows from two champions and only a few chips of crust fall away.

name: Litino
summary: Litino is a brown, many-tentacled medic who ferries wounded fighters out of battle and calms them with gentle touches. Litino carries a ring and a charging battery, shields patients with energy bubbles, and trusts will more than weapons.

feats.scene: Litino lashes a green bolt at a pirate gun battery and wrecks it.
Litino's energy bubble keeps a transport pod intact in a crossfire.

name: Riasuce
summary: Riasuce is a brown-haired hired gun who rides for a hard-hearted frontier boss. Riasuce dies in a dusty gunfight, with nothing to remember him by except a few unpaid debts.

feats.scene: Riasuce fires his revolver and drops a bottle from a fence post.
Riasuce absorbs a saloon brawl and sleeps it off.

name: Toriute
summary: Toriute is a black-haired outcast who finds a shaman's staff on a lonely island and soaks it in a brew to summon gales. Toriute terrorises a small hamlet from exile, descends from a landlord family, and his storms rouse a band of teenage heroes.

feats.scene: Toriute whips a funnel of wind through a harbour and tears a pier from its pilings.
Toriute is a thin man in a cape who can be knocked flat by a thrown rock.

name: Orisill
summary: Orisill is a black-haired storm-bringer in a possible tomorrow, still plotting against young heroes. Orisill conjures a monstrous hurricane to batter a peninsula until a mature team of champions stops him.

feats.scene: Orisill spins up a hurricane that threatens an entire coastline.
Orisill is knocked cold by a lunging rival after the storm collapses.

name: Stveoli
summary: Stveoli is a black-haired heir to a long line of masked guardians in a far-future century who trains alone after his father dies. Stveoli avenges his murdered parents, wields the best gadgets of his age and teams up with a mighty flier.

feats.scene: Stveoli swings a weighted grapple into a robot sentry and caves in its torso.
Stveoli is slammed into a steel wall and stays on his feet.

name: Iuulneo
summary: Iuulneo is a brown-haired robot controlled by two scheming aliens who entered a games contest for a power crystal. Iuulneo hurls objects farther than any rival and mocks a famous champion, though splashing water ruins his circuits.

feats.scene: Iuulneo throws a boulder the size of a house clear over the horizon.
Iuulneo shrugs off a ricochet from his own throw.

name: Anntileo
summary: Anntileo is a brown-skinned child of two engineered mutants, born naturally and kept as a living curiosity in a castle ballroom. Anntileo is freed by a charismatic fellow mutant and joins a long march to another continent.

feats.scene: Anntileo smashes a locked cellar gate with a shoulder charge.
Anntileo withstands a beating from guards and only grunts.

name: Taueorlli
summary: Taueorlli is a purple, yellow-eyed long-necked reptile hunter from a mirror-image world who flies, breathes flame and bears a hide like armour. Taueorlli serves a sinister master and is eventually killed by a rampaging giant.

feats.scene: Taueorlli exhales a cone of fire that burns a stand of forest to ash.
Taueorlli shrugs off a cannonade of boulders that would level a house.

name: Entrnu
summary: Entrnu is a blonde housemaid who loves her employer like a sister and wishes her happiness. Entrnu keeps the household running and is lost in the first two chapters of an adventure that is not hers.

feats.scene: Entrnu throws open a heavy curtain and lets sunlight into a gloomy hall.
Entrnu stays on her feet after tripping over a rug.

name: Saleoiu
summary: Saleoiu is a masked criminal known only by a gruesome title, recorded as one of several rogues beaten by a young hero. Saleoiu leaves hardly any trace beyond a vague reputation for menace.

feats.scene: Saleoiu clubs a guard with a heavy candlestick during a break-in.
Saleoiu is pounded into a wall by a young hero and goes quiet.

name: Rnoileva
summary: Rnoileva is a robed leader of a crimson-themed cult in a rainy island country who worships a demon lord. Rnoileva ends his own life as an offering, hoping to feed the creature he serves.

feats.scene: Rnoileva plunges a ritual knife into a stone altar and cracks it.
Rnoileva stands unmoving as his followers chant and the candles gutter.

name: Ariumci
summary: Ariumci is a grey-haired headmaster of a school for budding villains who bends minds with a gesture. Ariumci reads thoughts, throws illusions, hurls crimson concussive blasts and strikes with fists charged to cut through steel.

feats.scene: Ariumci hurls a red blast that caves in a dormitory wall and drops the roof.
Ariumci stands in a hail of cannon fire, the shells deflected by a faint red glow.

name: Rautorlu
summary: Rautorlu is a red-eyed, black-haired zealot who was infected by a swarming alien egg and now preaches union with the swarm. Rautorlu kidnaps a gifted girl, infects his followers, and boasts that two worlds will fall to his flock.

feats.scene: Rautorlu throws a trapped prisoner into a pit of his writhing followers.
Rautorlu stands unharmed as a rescuer's bolt strikes the lair roof.

name: Ilernillu
summary: Ilernillu is a giant robot with a single glassy lens and no hair or voice to speak of. Ilernillu serves as a sparring partner for a young hero's silly staring practice, and it never blinks.

feats.scene: Ilernillu swivels its lens and bats a juggling ball across the room.
Ilernillu is rammed by a runaway cart and is not even scuffed.

source_title: Brother Eye (Teen Titans Go! TV Series)

name: Stivalrni
summary: Stivalrni is a bald-headed priest of a criminal faith who rules a vast junkyard of rotting boats and teaches lessons in blood. Stivalrni falls in a duel with his own pupil, who inherits his seat.

feats.scene: Stivalrni drives a hard palm into a challenger's chest and sends him sprawling.
Stivalrni takes a savage beating on the deck of a derelict hull.

name: Senan
summary: Senan is a blond young man from a farming commune whose charisma draws followers and whose illness drives his visions. Senan sprouts feathered wings in times of crisis and rises into the air with them.

feats.scene: Senan sweeps his wings and knocks a startled neighbour off his feet.
Senan is thrown from a barn loft and takes flight before he lands.

name: Stcar
summary: Stcar is a brown-haired student demagogue who stirs a crowd by invoking a famous clown's menace. Stcar loses his nerve when the real thing shows up and is shut down with ease.

feats.scene: Stcar shoves a heckler off a campus podium.
Stcar is subdued in a single move and his rally ends.

name: Llesasam
summary: Llesasam is a blond ganglord who bosses a squad of thugs and keeps losing to a pint-sized hero. Llesasam meets a quick defeat after a single scuffle in a warehouse.

feats.scene: Llesasam smacks a lackey across the face for missing a payment.
Llesasam is bounced off crates by a tiny foe and stays down.

name: Ceoniium
summary: Ceoniium is a black-haired youngest son of an alien dynasty who inherits only half the family's power. Ceoniium grows into a bitter party boy, is tricked by a scientist into becoming a living bomb, and wakes up with no memory of the blast.

feats.scene: Ceoniium detonates the weapon hidden in his body and levels a hall.
Ceoniium and his twin stand in the fireball of a nuclear test as children and are only bruised.

name: Sataurer
summary: Sataurer is a brown-haired boy raised by two famous champions who escapes his dying world in a makeshift ship powered by a green ring and battery. Sataurer survives as the last of his world and drifts alone to a new planet.

feats.scene: Sataurer crashes through a hangar door at launch and rips the frame from its mount.
Sataurer rides out the shock wave of his world's final collapse inside the hull.

name: Tercist
summary: Tercist is a brown-furred pet hyena with strong claws, sharp fangs and a nose that never misses a trail. Tercist follows a wild mistress and somehow slips out of every near-death scrape.

feats.scene: Tercist bites through a heavy leather lead and bolts after a scent.
Tercist is kicked across a room and trots back, wagging.

name: Raniril
summary: Raniril is a six-foot-nine working-class engineer with a dark outfit who patrols a poor neighbourhood after dark. Raniril builds his own weapons and vehicles, outthinks gangsters, and keeps pushing forward in a city built to crush its poor.

feats.scene: Raniril drives a pipe through a mobster's armoured car door.
Raniril is flattened by a tractor-trailer bumper and rises to his feet.

name: Serrerela
summary: Serrerela is a black-haired, blue-eyed industrialist in an age of steam who dons a grey costume to haunt the city's criminals. Serrerela trains for ten years after his parents die and then uncovers a plot to arm a foreign power.

feats.scene: Serrerela flings a steam-pressure bomb that blows down a warehouse door.
Serrerela is hurled through a factory window and rolls up ready for another round.

name: Tiaines
summary: Tiaines is a gadget-loaded night vigilante whose intimidating reputation spreads by word of mouth. Tiaines is said to have struggled to balance a double life and was apparently wiped away when a wave of antimatter swept his universe.

feats.scene: Tiaines fires a grapple line that yanks a runaway thug off his feet.
Tiaines lands hard on a fire escape after a rooftop chase.

name: Colar
summary: Colar is a caped protector of a dark city in an alternate world, known to the public only through a newspaper report. Colar once captured a grinning clown criminal and is otherwise a rumour.

feats.scene: Colar tackles a clown-faced crook and pins him against a billboard.
Colar is thrown through a shop display and brushes off the glass.

name: Ereresti
summary: Ereresti is a blue-eyed costumed hero who joins an alliance against a wall of antimatter sweeping across the cosmos. Ereresti is erased with the rest, and a rebirth of reality later restores him elsewhere.

feats.scene: Ereresti hurls a hooked blade into a collapsing girder to hold it for others.
Ereresti stands his ground in a rain of debris before the wave takes him.

name: Irntiu
summary: Irntiu is a brown-haired psychologist who buys a notorious asylum to heal its inmates with kindness and dons a costume to bring in the worst of them. Irntiu is driven mad by laughing gas and ends up a patient in his own wards.

feats.scene: Irntiu knocks a raving inmate flat with a single shoulder block.
Irntiu sits unflinching as a cell door slams on his hand.

name: Telnaste
summary: Telnaste is a gruff, brilliant gadget-user who builds talking cars and bikes to help him fight crime. Telnaste knows demolitions, driving and stealth, and keeps the mood of his animated cave firmly serious.

feats.scene: Telnaste sets a shaped charge that drops a derelict bridge span into the river.
Telnaste rides a rough landing from a grappling swing without complaint.

name: Iasor
summary: Iasor is a black-haired retired hero and corporate chief whose daughter inherited a feline agility from her mother. Iasor lost his love to a shape-shifting killer, hung up the cowl, and stayed distant from his child for years.

feats.scene: Iasor lands a clean kick that sends a burglar over a desk.
Iasor works through the pain of a bad fall and still finishes the job.

name: Nutaril
summary: Nutaril is a heavyset, blue-eyed night fighter with no inborn powers but great stubbornness. Nutaril relies on acrobatics, martial training, stealth and tracking, wielding a rope, a belt of tools and a fast car.

feats.scene: Nutaril swings from a rope and drives both boots into a gunman's chest.
Nutaril takes a hard blow from a thug's pipe and keeps stalking.

name: Seonitiu
summary: Seonitiu is a fuzzy, knee-high ranger who carries a willpower ring and a charging battery from his far-off home. Underestimated by every big opponent, the little fighter proves them wrong with inventive glowing constructs.

feats.scene: Shaping a glowing mallet, the ranger flattens a hulking robot in one swing.
Inside a bright shell, the ranger shrugs off a barrage of missiles.

name: Anlleti
summary: Anlleti is a grey-furred cosmic constable guarding a quiet sector, whose ring once strayed into a schoolgirl's hands and woke its guiding mind. The small guardian retrieves it and goes back to patrolling.

feats.scene: Beaming a pulse from the ring, the constable cracks a floating rock in half.
Under a luminous dome, the constable takes a tumbling asteroid fragment.

name: Caarli
summary: Caarli is a deposed jungle tyrant who found a wrecked starship and ruled with its stolen marvels until an angry populace drove him off. Centuries later the hoarder hunts every scattered device and the secret of a life-lengthening tonic.

feats.scene: Pointing a recovered gadget at a ruin, the tyrant blows a temple wall to gravel.
Struck by a thrown boulder, the old ruler staggers but stays upright.

name: Tentenas
summary: Tentenas is a loyal scout who trails a wandering hero on a hard quest through hostile kingdoms, carrying water and lookout duty. The helper is brave, but only a plain fighter with a short blade.

feats.scene: Hacking with a short blade, the scout cuts through a rope bridge.
Thrown from a mule, the helper lands hard and keeps walking.

name: Vaton
summary: Vaton is a sorceress who learned a rite that lets her swallow and hurl bolts of electricity and melt into a crackling streak. Her lightning can strip magical champions of their powers, but police batons still end the fight.

feats.scene: Hurling a thick bolt, the sorceress blows apart a power pylon.
Turning to a streak of living current, the sorceress races along a cable.

name: Niuos
summary: Niuos is a hulking conjured menace dragging a spiked iron ball on a long chain and bound to serve a mysterious puppeteer. Each swing of the heavy weapon rings off walls and cars like a bell.

feats.scene: Whirling the spiked ball overhead, the brute smashes a parked sedan.
Hit by a pickup truck, the brute swats it aside.

name: Ilsil
summary: Ilsil is a black-haired mercenary lieutenant from a hollow world beneath the crust, sly with a bow, a sword and a horse, and eager to stab his own captain. Slain by a single pistol shot, the schemer is revived by a sorcerer who likes his spite.

feats.scene: Loosing an arrow, the archer pins a deserter's sleeve to a tree trunk.
Buried by a rockslide in the high passes, the mercenary crawls out bruised.

name: Elonenel
summary: Elonenel is a grey-haired ancient sea and storm deity hiding in a forgotten village of weathered ocean spirits, wearing several names like waves wear foam. Born of a race of cosmic elders, the goddess is aware of every realm and nearly limitless in strength.

feats.scene: Calling a tempest across the whole sea, the goddess drowns a coastline under a wall of water.
Struck by a rain of spells, the goddess does not even flinch.

name: Viinuau
summary: Viinuau is a gambler who sold his soul to a devil and was rewarded with a spotted hide, claws, fangs and a temper he cannot always hold. Rage sometimes takes over the half-beast and wrecks everything around him.

feats.scene: Slashing with a clawed fist, the jaguar-man shreds the side of a delivery truck.
Bounding down a street, the beast outruns a police cruiser.

name: Amonol
summary: Amonol is a golden-furred agent of a patrol of space dogs who can become any animal at will. The scout slips into hostile camps as a lizard or a bird, then drops the disguise when needed.

feats.scene: Turning into a charging bull, the agent bowls over a bandit.
Crushed under a toppled crate, the agent shifts shape and slips free.

name: Tisres
summary: Tisres is a two-thousand-year-old northern conqueror with a bloody reputation, who pursued a defiant princess until a stranger from another age arrived. Armoured in lacquered plates, the warlord leads cavalry charges personally.

feats.scene: Cleaving with a curved sword, the warlord splits a shield and the arm behind it.
Struck by a spear thrown from a hill, the warlord stays in the saddle.

name: Valstu
summary: Valstu is a bald mad scientist with a giant smooth egg for a body and red eyes, bolted with machinery and fond of grand speeches. The inventor joins a gathering of brilliant minds as the laws of nature start to fray.

feats.scene: Firing a shoulder-mounted cannon, the egg-bodied inventor wrecks a lab bench and wall.
Rolled off a gantry onto stone, the shell holds without a crack.

name: Nuslitor
summary: Nuslitor is a young medicine woman who lost her family to a cruel injustice and turned her inherited rites into a weapon of vengeance. She can change her face, take the form of beasts and bend minds with a stare.

feats.scene: Chanting a curse, the sorceress hurls a swarm of spectral hawks that crack a window wall.
Buried beneath a collapsed building, the sorceress is feared dead.

name: Eostrn
summary: Eostrn is a grieving young mother who lost her three-year-old son to a speeding car and could not carry the sorrow. Her quiet life of cooking, singing and tending a small garden ends in tragedy.

feats.scene: Hurling a vase against a wall, the mother shatters it in anguish.
Holding her son's small coat for a year, the mother endures longer than anyone knows.

name: Sernenu
summary: Sernenu is a green-haired fallen deity of madness who once toppled a sunken empire and now sells sandwiches in a busy city after his source of magic went dark. A returning tide of sorcery tempts the owner back toward old habits.

feats.scene: Unleashing the full black tide, the deity drowns a sea-girt empire in a single night.
Ground down by years of exile, the shopkeeper simply keeps slicing meat.

name: Artenan
summary: Artenan is a masked revolutionary who seizes a nuclear submarine with her comrades and later is forced into a coerced team of disposable fighters. Quick fists and sharp training let the rebel break a larger fighter's nose.

feats.scene: Whipping a kick through the air, the rebel snaps a hostile soldier's jaw.
Flung against a bulkhead during a boarding, the rebel gets up and fights on.

name: Tauna
summary: Tauna is a green-haired lord of disorder with no eyes at all, who lends a stolen mantle of fate to a chosen host and hopes to spread confusion across the land. Matter, luck and reality itself bend when the immortal gestures.

feats.scene: Waving a hand, the lord flips every sign and street in a district upside down.
Struck by a pair of rival sorcerers, the lord loses a limb of mist and grows it back.

name: Linloiu
summary: Linloiu is a red-haired gang boss who killed the owner of a power ring and wore it as a crown of violence. Thugs who fail the crook often die for it, until a rival finally takes the ring back.

feats.scene: Pointing the ring, the gangster blasts a hole in a steel warehouse door.
Shot in a rooftop ambush, the gangster stumbles and shoots back.

name: Ronton
summary: Ronton is a masked rider of an iron-wheeled war chariot who rolls through back streets with a gambler's crew, rattling shop windows and scattering pedestrians. Not much is recorded about the driver beyond a flair for noise.

feats.scene: Ramming a stone gatepost, the charioteer smashes it and the wheel rim.
Whipping the horses down a boulevard, the rider outpaces a taxi.

name: Iaresntu
summary: Iaresntu is a brown-eyed palace guard of a hidden island of warrior women, trained with bow, horse and sword and prone to bitter grudges. A trusted shield of the royal circle, the warrior takes her duty very seriously.

feats.scene: Swinging a bronze sword, the guard severs a training post in one stroke.
Struck by a thrown spear, the warrior turns it aside on her shield.

name: Tumllu
summary: Tumllu is a hairless, tree-like giant from a far-off planet who joins a band of rebel fighters, strong, durable and nearly unbreakable. Few things can pierce the thick bark of the hulking soldier.

feats.scene: Swinging a gnarled arm, the giant smashes a bulkhead flat.
Hit by a heavy cannon at point-blank range, the giant sways and lumbers on.

name: Neosilll
summary: Neosilll is a tall heiress who survived the murder of her entire family and plotted her revenge in a prison cell for years. Her vision for the city is a shining one, built on flames.

feats.scene: Slashing with a ceremonial blade, the schemer carves a deep cut into a wooden pillar.
Locked in solitary for years, the prisoner emerges with a cold smile.

name: Nitas
summary: Nitas is a white-haired emperor of a vast medieval realm, remembered for law, learning and an ever-growing family tree. Seated in a stone palace, the old monarch commands armies and scribes alike.

feats.scene: Swinging a battle sword on a campaign, the emperor hacks through a leather shield.
Thrown from his horse at a river ford, the monarch lands in the mud and laughs.

name: Coser
summary: Coser is a script writer for a radio station in a grey, rain-swept port, accused of unpopular politics and crushed by the suspicion. A scholarship is later set up in the dead scribe's name.

feats.scene: Hammering the keys of a typewriter, the writer wakes the whole office at midnight.
Hounded by rumours for months, the writer finally breaks down.

name: Ronias
summary: Ronias is a gaudy criminal who rides a large kite-shaped glider and has become a running joke for a pacifist hero in a bragging story. The flyer is little threat but is forever returning.

feats.scene: Dropping from a glider, the criminal drives both heels into a guard.
Catching a stiff updraft, the flyer sails over a rail yard.

name: Lonteva
summary: Lonteva is a young law firm intern who pulls on a glider cape and a mask to carry on the work of a famous night guardian. An early patrol goes badly, but quick thinking and a thrown knife save a partner.

feats.scene: Throwing a borrowed blade, the intern kills a coiled python in one cast.
Beaten by thugs in a warehouse, the intern feigns unconsciousness and waits.

name: Veost
summary: Veost is a cheerful cab driver whose best friend is an occult trickster, who is infected by a plague of hollow hunger and lunges at his companion. A burning car and a quick escape end the nightmare.

feats.scene: Lunging at his old friend, the infected driver pins him against the car door.
Set alight by his horrified companion, the driver burns to nothing.

name: Liali
summary: Liali is a roadie turned taxi driver and the oldest friend of a reckless occult hustler, who has survived by staying out of the magic. A last drive with a fake bomb ends in a fireball.

feats.scene: Slamming a car door on a heckler, the driver rattles the whole street.
Caught in the blast of a cab packed with explosives, the driver dies confused.

name: Auloluium
summary: Auloluium is a bald, loyal taxi driver who ferries a masked friend through crowded avenues in a battered cab with a pet name. The cabbie offers honest advice and does not judge anyone.

feats.scene: Cranking the wheel hard, the driver sideswipes a thug's getaway car.
Bumped by a speeding delivery van, the driver climbs out and waves it off.

name: Aulrnnto
summary: Aulrnnto is a kind man with a clouded mind who works behind a corner shop counter and believes he is a caped crusader from an old television show. Neighbours happily play along, and the cheerful dreamer inspires a friend to clean up her life.

feats.scene: Swinging a broom handle, the clerk tangles a dealer's legs.
Beaten in an alley by hired heavies, the clerk stays down until the street rallies.

name: Cinseso
summary: Cinseso is a quiet circuit engineer who once owed his life to a fellow soldier and repays the debt by adopting the man's orphaned son. A move to a friendlier town gives the boy a better life.

feats.scene: Hoisting a heavy transformer onto a bench, the engineer finishes the repair.
Hit by a stray bullet in battle, the soldier is carried to safety.

name: Esiela
summary: Esiela is a crime lord who rules much of a rainy capital, in a feud with a rival from the coal country and boasting of royal descent. Locked in a basement cell, the crook keeps tabs on his family's schemes.

feats.scene: Slamming a cane on the table, the boss makes his lieutenants flinch.
Held in a windowless cell for years, the boss still runs the streets by letter.

name: Stoliu
summary: Stoliu is a patrolman who dresses in a motley suit with bells to confuse criminals with quips, claiming a court-fool ancestor. The funny crusader fights beside a band of wartime heroes until a final stand.

feats.scene: Whipping a baton in a tight arc, the patrolman drops two bandits.
Beaten in a back alley by a pack of robbers, the patrolman keeps joking.

name: Nancanu
summary: Nancanu is a bright student in a boarding academy for young heroes who studies healing arts and carries a satchel of notes. Classmates call the diligent pupil a future medic with a talent for tests.

feats.scene: Tossing a textbook across the lecture hall, the student bonks a prankster.
Tumbling down the dormitory steps, the pupil collects the dropped notes.

name: Niuliaau
summary: Niuliaau is a sightless surgeon with a knack for finding his way through the dark who joins an old squad of veteran crimefighters. Medical training is his best tool and his handicap rarely slows him.

feats.scene: Landing a precise jab in the dark, the surgeon drops a startled guard.
Knocked down in a scuffle, the surgeon feels his way back to his feet.

source_title: Charles McNider (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Oseon
summary: Oseon is a blond forest worker with a head injury who comes to believe he is a purple-clad raider and leads a gang of costumed fakes. A friendly stretchy hero eventually restores the woodsman's memory.

feats.scene: Swinging a felling axe, the woodsman splits a log clean through.
Knocked on the head by a falling branch, the woodsman wakes with a new identity.

name: Valsor
summary: Valsor is a nine-foot, half-ton cyborg who longed from boyhood to carry rockets on his shoulders and abandoned his marriage to make it real. Sociopathic and sturdy, the mercenary brags that he could take over a whole continent.

feats.scene: Firing both shoulder rockets, the cyborg levels a small block of storefronts.
Shot at close range by a squad, the cyborg stays standing and survives.

name: Eoeonnan
summary: Eoeonnan is a plucky, stocky young hero who turns into a rubbery ball and rebounds off walls to shrug off blows. Elected leader in the field, the cheerful bouncer is also a surprisingly good pilot.

feats.scene: Rebounding off three walls in a row, the bouncer slams into a robot guard.
Hit by a heavy hammer, the ball form bounces away unhurt.

source_title: Charles Taine (Legion of Super-Heroes TV Series)

name: Anucoeon
summary: Anucoeon is a blue-eyed scientist with a doctorate who can swell into a hard sphere and ricochet at great speed without ever being hurt. Persuaded to join a team of rebels, the physicist shows that bouncing is the whole point.

feats.scene: Careening off a wall, the ball form smashes through a row of crates.
Rammed by a heavy transport, the sphere shrugs it off.

name: Taust
summary: Taust is a stocky young man who drank a strange plastic fluid by accident and can now inflate into a hard rolling sphere. Rejected twice by the hero club, he wins his place when his rubbery body defeats an electric villain.

feats.scene: Rolling into a squad of guards, the sphere bowls them down like pins.
Bounced off a steel wall at speed, the sphere is not even scuffed.

name: Irntaurn
summary: Irntaurn is a blond young rebel from a bleak future who was electrocuted in a factory brawl and became a being of living current. As a spy among the dictator's troops, the youth later flees with other rebels.

feats.scene: Hurling a bolt of power, the rebel blows apart a transformer station.
Streaking through the air as a charged streak, the rebel leaves a sparking trail.

name: Nauiarnau
summary: Nauiarnau is a wiry fighter pilot who keeps the radio shack humming on a hidden island base and mimics enemy officers over the airwaves. Multilingual and a sharp shot, the airman sings with the squadron on the way home.

feats.scene: Firing from the cockpit, the pilot knocks a gun from a captor's hand.
Diving in a propeller fighter, the pilot outruns an enemy interceptor.

name: Lliori
summary: Lliori is a white-haired gem smuggler who dodges arrest by hiding in a carved sarcophagus, then rigs a trap room out of stolen trophies. Lliori is clever but careless, and the final blast locks him inside his own hiding place.

feats.scene: Lliori lobs a grenade across the trophy room and shatters a display case.
Lliori curls behind a stone lid as the blast rolls over him.

name: Seeoser
summary: Seeoser is a black-haired inventor who built a time machine and wands to summon ancient warlords so they would steal rare metal for him. Seeoser flatters his guests, flies his own gadgets, and loses to a band of seven masked rivals.

feats.scene: Seeoser waves a wand and a phantom battalion of conquerors tramples a steel mill.
Seeoser tumbles from his flying rig and lands in a hedge.

name: Lorntte
summary: Lorntte is a bald alien from the second planet who plugs himself into humming machinery and takes on a shape-shifting rival. Lorntte is mostly a rumour, a crackling menace from an old space comic.

feats.scene: Lorntte discharges a coil and a crackling arc blows a hatch off its rail.
Lorntte absorbs a stun beam and hums louder.

name: Serorirn
summary: Serorirn is a multi-armed alien sorcerer who serves cosmic order and wears an ancient helm of ancestral power. Serorirn flies, teleports, and can raise the fallen, and treats chaos as a disease to be cured.

feats.scene: Serorirn lifts a ruined tower from the street with a gesture and sets it down intact.
Serorirn stands inside a collapsing spell storm and keeps chanting.

name: Cotiu
summary: Cotiu is a bald criminal whose skin gives off a glow that bends anyone watching to his orders. Cotiu uses the glow to enlist sailors for a pirate submarine.

feats.scene: Cotiu flares his skin and a whole dock crew marches onto his ship.
Cotiu grits his teeth as a rival's club glances off his head.

name: Rnuamoam
summary: Rnuamoam is a pale ancient warlock whose long burial seeped dread into the soil of a city built above him. Rnuamoam claims the place's name in a fit of pride and carries a cloak that opens onto a pocket realm of relics.

feats.scene: Rnuamoam stamps his foot and a hundred rooftops split with black lightning.
Rnuamoam wades through a rival witch's firestorm with his cloak barely scorched.

name: Orene
summary: Orene is a calm hospital physician in a small farm town, trusted by neighbours through car wrecks and gunshots. Orene has no powers, only steady hands and tired eyes.

feats.scene: Orene braces an orderly's arm and pushes a stretcher through swinging doors.
Orene works through a double shift and a power cut without sitting down.

name: Nolanilo
summary: Nolanilo is a bodiless alien convict freed from a prison dimension, wearing a physician's face that may not be real. Nolanilo traps a farmer in a nightmare ward until a green ally helps drag him back.

feats.scene: Nolanilo bends a barn into a hospital corridor and drags a farmer through the door.
Nolanilo drifts through a hail of thrown tools without a mark.

name: Corcelnu
summary: Corcelnu is a white-haired scientist mocked by his peers who built an apparatus that turns another dimension's mist into solid matter, then used it to mint a gang of stunted burglars. Corcelnu serves time, reforms, and ends up helping his old rival's firm.

feats.scene: Corcelnu runs his machine and a squad of stunted thieves steps out of the mist.
Corcelnu shields his face as the machine overloads and showers sparks.

name: Reolan
summary: Reolan is a brown-haired scientist whose skin glows with a deadly green mineral, a poison to a certain flying alien. Reolan works for a crime syndicate and can sicken anyone he touches.

feats.scene: Reolan shakes a hand and a whole room of guards drops with burning skin.
Reolan lets a thug's pipe bounce off his glowing shoulder.

name: Numstu
summary: Numstu is a ghoulish genius who revives corpses with a bright alloy and prefers graveyards to company. Numstu once built coded coins and a secret book for a nocturnal cabal, and now lives under protection in a walled garden.

feats.scene: Numstu jolts a cold corpse with a coin of glowing metal and it sits up.
Numstu survives a century of hunting with nothing but a limp.

name: Alliasi
summary: Alliasi is a bald scientist who builds weapons out of light and tries them on a blind rival physician. Alliasi has no powers, only glare, patience and clever lenses.

feats.scene: Alliasi fires a focused beam that cuts a hole in a sheet of steel.
Alliasi staggers from a thrown beaker and grabs a lens before it breaks.

name: Rauasiiu
summary: Rauasiiu is a black-haired heroine of a mirror-world team, who fights teenage tyrants and helps visitors flee. Rauasiiu flies and holds a line with her friends so strangers can escape.

feats.scene: Rauasiiu dives onto a tyrant's tank and flips it onto its roof.
Rauasiiu holds the doorway under a blast of laser fire while the visitors run.

source_title: Doctor Light (Teen Titans TV Series: Wrong Place, Wrong Time)

name: Tanraulu
summary: Tanraulu is a dark-haired private eye who investigates the supernatural and carries a talisman for calling restless ghosts. Tanraulu is consulted when a madman is tormented by a spirit, and he sends a helper into the victim's head.

feats.scene: Tanraulu raises the talisman and a pale spirit rises from the floor.
Tanraulu shrugs off a flying chair thrown by an angry poltergeist.

name: Oneraeon
summary: Oneraeon is a grey-eyed chemist who inherited a grandmother's trade in poisons and joined a gang of rogues. Oneraeon chooses toxins over fists, and her hands are quick with a vial.

feats.scene: Oneraeon flicks a vial across the room and a guard drops snoring.
Oneraeon takes a hard shove into a rack of flasks and keeps her feet.

name: Estnen
summary: Estnen is a hero of a parallel world who is captured by a gang of villains and later freed by a visiting caped ally. Estnen helps topple the gang and presumably keeps guard over a quiet home world.

feats.scene: Estnen tears a cell door from the wall and throws it at a guard.
Estnen endures a beating in a villain's cell without giving up a name.

source_title: Doctor Polaris (The Brave and the Bold: Deep Cover for Batman!)

name: Rnanter
summary: Rnanter is a black-eyed criminal with a taste for mental tricks and a long grudge against a certain Amazon. Rnanter schemes in the background of a cartoon-style adventure series.

feats.scene: Rnanter whispers a command and a policeman hands over his keys.
Rnanter flinches from a punch and slips out through a vent.

source_title: Doctor Psycho (The Brave and the Bold)

name: Neviaun
summary: Neviaun is a grey-haired criminal genius who reads minds, bends wills and conjures illusions to pursue his schemes. Neviaun is a gifted electrical engineer whose mind is his sharpest weapon.

feats.scene: Neviaun projects a false sky of fire and an entire crowd runs screaming.
Neviaun reels from a blow but keeps his concentration intact.

name: Teranvau
summary: Teranvau is a black-haired sorcerer who styles himself monarch of all things uncanny and clashes with a supernatural sleuth. Teranvau brews a potion that lets an evil ally linger in this world, but only briefly.

feats.scene: Teranvau chants a spell and a flaming portal wrecks a library wing.
Teranvau staggers out of a rival's curse with his robes smoking.

name: Nelnorte
summary: Nelnorte is a quiet criminal known by a name that promises stillness, who vanishes before anyone sees his face. Nelnorte appears in a single old adventure as an enemy of a radio-themed hero.

feats.scene: Nelnorte cuts a transmitter line and an entire broadcast falls silent.
Nelnorte drops from a loading dock and lands without a sound.

name: Tesasi
summary: Tesasi is a failed healer turned circus act whose prisms and light projector can drive an audience to rage or sorrow. Tesasi falls into his own red beam, goes mad with anger, and vows revenge on everyone who laughed.

feats.scene: Tesasi sweeps a red beam across the bleachers and the crowd turns on itself.
Tesasi shrugs off a thrown bottle and flares his lamps brighter.

name: Noloreru
summary: Noloreru is a white-haired alien from the outermost world, a stern, scheming figure from an old space comic. Noloreru is poorly recorded, but always appears behind some crooked bargain.

feats.scene: Noloreru turns a dial and a hovering barge slams into a docking spar.
Noloreru stays upright through a collision and sneers.

name: Linrnirni
summary: Linrnirni is a blond geneticist who took over a laboratory in a neon future city. Linrnirni is proud of a family trait for focus and has no powers beyond patience.

feats.scene: Linrnirni slaps a switch and a sample vault hisses open.
Linrnirni keeps working while an alarm shakes a rack of vials onto the floor.

name: Orest
summary: Orest is a black-haired woman with a crooked grin who haunts a pint-sized pest's stories under a clinical alias. Orest left little record, but her name promises hurt.

feats.scene: Orest swings a steel tray into a guard's shield and sends him sprawling.
Orest topples off a gantry and lands on her feet.

name: Olval
summary: Olval is a bald ruler from a hidden artificial planet who led a crime syndicate before dying in a squad's mission. Olval used to be called the supreme decider and trusted his own scheming above all.

feats.scene: Olval commands a fleet of crime-skiffs to ram a customs barge and it bursts open.
Olval waves off a thrown goblet and orders his guards forward.

name: Corleo
summary: Corleo is a dog-faced cyborg hired by a scheming tyrant to kill a rebel leader. Corleo is strong, mechanical, and goes down with the rest of his hired band when a psychic burst knocks them out.

feats.scene: Corleo tears a bulkhead off a crashed ship and throws it across the rocks.
Corleo walks through a barrage of rifle fire with sparks along his plating.

name: Ontlornti
summary: Ontlornti is an ordinary salesman who picks up a cursed welding torch in a junk shop and gets compelled to fuse pets to people. Ontlornti loses his family to the curse and watches from the shadows.

feats.scene: Ontlornti throws a blazing torch at a doorway and the frame melts into slag.
Ontlornti staggers back from a kitchen knife and slumps to the curb.

name: Sannesau
summary: Sannesau is a grey-eyed cigar-chewing investigator in a ruined future country, an assistant to a bounty hunter and a fan of deduction. Sannesau rides a three-wheeled bike and speaks in cheerful local slang.

feats.scene: Sannesau cracks a cudgel on a bandit's wrist and revs his bike away.
Sannesau tumbles off a wall into a hay cart and tips his hat.

name: Teltau
summary: Teltau is an engineer of a distant planet's ancient past who built mechanical wings fuelled by a rare element. Teltau discovers the fuel trails deadly radiation, vows never to fly again, and lives with his own hubris.

feats.scene: Teltau fires the wing engines and the launch scaffold bursts into flames.
Teltau skims over a river valley on the fuelled wings and trails a glowing wake.

name: Ninenlor
summary: Ninenlor is a red-eyed, red-haired villain with horns and a blazing sword, trading on a devilish alias. Ninenlor flies, hits hard, and shrugs off blows, and conjures solid constructs of energy.

feats.scene: Ninenlor swings her sword and a wave of fire levels a warehouse row.
Ninenlor stands in a collapsing hangar and walks out unmarked.

name: Asilliaul
summary: Asilliaul is a red-eyed minor god of lies, who plots with his sister to steal a legendary flame and ends up jailed behind a sealed door. Asilliaul flies, teleports and weaves illusions, and runs when a blade-thrust plan fails.

feats.scene: Asilliaul spins a lie into a mirage army that crushes an olive grove.
Asilliaul takes a heroine's lasso across the chest and slips away laughing.

name: Iaveli
summary: Iaveli is a white-haired heroine of the deep, one of the few survivors after a plague that spared only women. Iaveli joins a revived league of heroes and holds the sea lanes.

feats.scene: Iaveli drives a harpoon through a trawler hull and sinks it.
Iaveli rides a deep-sea pressure surge and surfaces unharmed.

name: Rnoantor
summary: Rnoantor is a white-haired sea-dweller from a drowned kingdom who joins a league of heroes in a grim alternate world. Rnoantor is recorded in little detail, a calm figure in the crowd.

feats.scene: Rnoantor swings a trident into a hull and splinters a plank.
Rnoantor shrugs off a dockside beating and strides back into the surf.

name: Rnisena
summary: Rnisena is a hulking former sea mammal, over six feet tall, rebuilt by cruel scientists with human limbs. Rnisena freed his kin from a park tank and later sends a mental cry that makes a crowd feel the captives' fear.

feats.scene: Rnisena pounds on a steel gate until it buckles and the pool drains.
Rnisena shrugs off a spear-gun bolt meant for him.

name: Nuseote
summary: Nuseote is a bald full-time crook with a dome-shaped moniker who tangles with a pair of flying young heroes. Nuseote has no powers and relies on muscle and nerve.

feats.scene: Nuseote rams a stolen van through a shop window and grabs the till.
Nuseote takes a tumble down a fire escape and keeps running.

name: Niuvalle
summary: Niuvalle is a dark-haired big-city villain with a round-headed handle and a grudge against a famous flier. Niuvalle appears briefly and leaves little behind but cracked glass.

feats.scene: Niuvalle slams a mallet onto a bank door and dents the frame.
Niuvalle shrugs off a tumble across a car hood.

name: Anuauern
summary: Anuauern is a tall purple-eyed preacher who runs a cult as a front for an alien master's invasion. Anuauern cons followers, takes over minds when talk fails, and can lend strength to others.

feats.scene: Anuauern stretches his hands and a whole congregation rises and marches in step.
Anuauern tumbles from a pulpit and rises with a smile.

name: Iuinsi
summary: Iuinsi is a dark-haired city resident who gains the gift of reading minds when a bus is washed in strange radiation. Iuinsi is kidnapped, sold, and robbed of his body by a scheming mastermind.

feats.scene: Iuinsi staggers forward and shoves a captor away.
Iuinsi endures a spike in the neck and still tries to warn his rescuer.

name: Amniu
summary: Amniu is a former army man who carries his dead platoon's tags and fights with spirits at his side. Amniu bangs his iron cuffs together to throw up a barrier or loose a shock, and now guards a new coastal city.

feats.scene: Amniu claps his cuffs and a shock wave flattens a row of raiders.
Amniu crouches behind a shimmering barrier as a tidal surge breaks over him.

name: Tirarveo
summary: Tirarveo is a soldier who fights in chains, clashing his shackles for a shield or a concussive blast. Tirarveo wears tags tied to his fallen friends and calls on their ghosts to steady his aim and mend wounds.

feats.scene: Tirarveo drives his shackles together and a pulse knocks a gunman off a roof.
Tirarveo hunches inside a glowing shell while a truck bounces off it.
